name: Hermes Agent v0.23.2
body:
# Hermes Agent v0.23.2

**Release Date:** November 16, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~1,989 PRs merged since v0.23.1 into a stable release for the GitHub release (CLI and installers), the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.24.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## About this release

Measured at commit `ae2a81ccc00`, the window since v0.23.1 contains **7,918 non-merge commits** across **5,211 changed files** (+239,733 / −22,788), **1,989 merged PRs** and **940 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: durable subagents that survive a gateway restart or crash and can be continued on their own conversation, one prompt-cache clock per session, `hermes fallback check` for fallback-chain readiness, `hermes update --force` to stop gateways at once instead of draining, one-time browser_vault codes entered from Telegram and Discord, opt-in shared Telegram DM threads, the Gemini Interactions API by default for Gemini 3 and later plus Gemini 4 Carbon, fast mode for Claude Mythos 5.2, per-job cron options (`wrap_response`, a fresh thread per run), new plugin APIs (`ctx.fork_session`, `ctx.redact_text()`, `ctx.register_idle_task`), compatibility shims so updates work across module moves, a slimmer macOS bundle that installs Chromium on first use, and a large batch of new plugin-catalog entries.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.24.0**, which will document everything from v0.23.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Fixed in the release candidate

- Desktop chats created by an August build with a bare `custom` provider can send again after updating (#156545).
- A Desktop or TUI reply that streamed beside a todo or memory call now settles instead of leaving the Stop button up (#156553).
- A crash mid-stream on Telegram and other edit-streaming chats no longer shows a duplicate "Recovered reply"; a word holding a key prefix mid-word (`program_id`) is shown on time again (#156546).
- Desktop no longer loses or scrambles what you type while it starts and resumes your last chat (#156615, #156642).
- After a reconnect mid-reply, Desktop shows the reply once and in full, attachments included (#156611).
- In the Webapp, opening Hermes Cloud agents while this install isn't signed in to Nous Portal now tells you to sign in to Nous Portal instead of sending you to the Webapp login (#156652).
- Exiting the CLI while its startup update check is waiting on GitHub no longer leaves `git` running (#156616).

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.23.1...v0.23.2](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.23.1...v0.23.2)

body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.61

Released on 2026-11-17.

Received projects and the files they reach stay inside their own folder across render, preview and Studio, and a sealed preview reloads in place in a fraction of a second. This release also carries every change listed for 0.9.60. That version never reached npm: its publish was refused because it ran from the release PR's merge ref, and since #8020 a stable release publishes from the push to `main` that merges it.

## Features

- **Engine:** Render telemetry says why a page cannot reuse still frames ([c8df284b2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c8df284b2ed15ae0ade05bf90e95192d05f3d1c6), [#7993](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7993)).
- **Studio:** An element's source-parsed animations are part of Studio's API ([efc91fc87](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/efc91fc877d89d8057611dd87c81220be46df9a2), [#8061](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8061)).
- **Producer:** Enforce expected output dimensions before capture ([8a13b2caf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8a13b2cafaea14b19ff3275cab6f156845e1537c), [#7871](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7871)).

## Fixes

- **Producer, Parsers:** Render compile never looks for a scene's assets on another computer ([524ea46bf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/524ea46bf9d3fbf965fdb129506a830dbacd98df), [#8063](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8063)).
- **CLI:** Refuse media-proxy copies another site asks for in play and the static server ([f97e28905](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f97e289058adb5ad5f04982bf8be3245abb59b54), [#8058](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8058)).
- **Producer:** Readers re-check outside-linked compositions, and the refusal names a step every surface can take ([4721739ee](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4721739ee702725abaca88e3ebb1dc9af6fd8288), [#8034](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8034)).
- **CLI:** Leave files from outside the project out of Lambda and Cloud Run site uploads ([39347da9d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/39347da9de71923d4bd9f1acd3c8b6f28368a4d7), [#8060](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8060)).
- **CLI:** A host can name projects whose received files are expected or all received ([5ea86450a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5ea86450a21fe80a9817420a2aab84261f41f3d7), [#8025](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8025)).
- **Core:** Only Studio's own preview pages get the editing port, and undo sets only safe attributes ([55291c00c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/55291c00c26b83d8a72c1a16fb957d0dcb7735aa), [#8057](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8057)).
- **Lint:** Match a timed wrapper's close tag literally ([3e01f691d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3e01f691dbf44e4b1ce7b7d20cceede5df111636), [#8028](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8028)).
- **Studio:** Each drag shows as its own undo step once its save lands ([647bdd4d7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/647bdd4d7c3f376cae2963ace3b093d25ddf1b85), [#8033](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8033)).
- **CLI:** A refused reverse start reports whether HeyGen sent the refusal ([53080581c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/53080581cbef16b55cc8201054127232293c799b), [#8053](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8053)).
- **Producer:** Cap a render's total sub-composition expansion ([b29e40d70](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b29e40d707d6942953265e0dfc90a18fd98f654e), [#8045](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8045)).
- **Inspector:** The inspector's Chrome starts as root or in a container ([f91bbf0da](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f91bbf0dac486f85de195621092014c02bf0a6a5), [#8050](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8050)).
- Refuse media paths that ffmpeg's image2 demuxer would read as a pattern ([fe93f9cd4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fe93f9cd47f1a1d027c0948ea20fda22769ccebe), [#8047](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8047)).
- **CLI:** A project .env provider key gives way to the person's own credential ([14c4e4c26](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/14c4e4c268dc3dd4df0f4299151260d9839be8d0), [#8041](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8041)).
- **CLI:** Escape audio and media-use output, pin model files ([c4439890c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c4439890cfbcdbc16d48f1a4b05176abe0138cae), [#8013](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8013)).
- **Producer:** Keep the probe stage's media pre-checks linear in page size ([e21f56dca](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e21f56dcad6d2afe8a650b53b41df396959c07f5), [#8044](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8044)).
- **Studio:** Colour grading works in a sealed preview ([d7d416124](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d7d416124f46a3c10066adba86be715907425762), [#7999](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7999)).
- **Engine:** Bound the proxied host pre-check by the download's timeout ([06b632017](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/06b632017c98824119c4a1ba755d3113108fbf45), [#8048](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8048)).
- **Engine:** The GPU, host-ceiling and HDR launches keep the sandbox where the host allows it ([7b27fbc84](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7b27fbc84ab3134f3d86b0e6baee7f55554965d6), [#8038](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8038)).
- **Studio Server:** Cache reads never follow a link the project ships ([70820b386](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/70820b386fb1fbaedc58c87cdaed3abcca034772), [#8039](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8039)).
- **Engine:** Check proxied download hosts; keep raw GIF downloads private ([5fcce21a6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5fcce21a645a2bad0fec0e2dc62e08a9af596430), [#8040](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8040)).
- **Skills:** Locate.mjs reads the system font in place, not a shared /tmp copy ([5b2990fc1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5b2990fc10dbb2ad5806de665b8fa4ede2c175b6), [#8042](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8042)).
- **Studio:** Caption editing works in a sealed preview ([915021265](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/915021265fb452bd6812bad1d1fb318b8cc060b1), [#8002](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8002)).
- **Producer:** Cap the software encoder to the cores capture leaves free ([f89f6d3d4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f89f6d3d4b88e6656de782019fa26f3a60df730d), [#8019](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8019)).
- **Studio:** A sealed preview's reload shows in a fraction of a second, not after 8 s ([9daa7e876](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9daa7e876d7b4e507dafb64139ee2dd08901bd5e), [#8015](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8015)).
- **Skills:** Run bundled TTS helpers from the skill folder, not the working directory ([6115945cf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6115945cf4e6fd1989ab5d7572cc845c3cff9606), [#8035](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8035)).
- A received-files record follows Studio renames, moves and deletes, and a nested record can't be moved out of reach ([f5bb3e551](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f5bb3e5519bf9a76ac1d770234fb65fe7f152832), [#7989](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7989)).
- **Studio Server:** A loopback page with no fetch metadata is marked unless the app framed it ([b6e1e8dda](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b6e1e8dda9f1ce86927ad130c0a6a33f04e9e8d4), [#8017](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8017)).
- **Studio:** The copied render command carries no composition text a shell can run ([19743ea09](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/19743ea094defcc90cd18108d757acfb6021851a), [#8012](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8012)).
- The dev Studio's renders follow the received-project rule, and a received project's .env keys never replace the person's own ([8239fe470](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8239fe47021604532e1e9136e713adf634be45a2), [#8004](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8004)).
- **Producer:** Trusted renders refuse outside-linked compositions unless --include-outside-files ([00d03a412](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/00d03a412236bc48c56deb0ec8516602ea30c780), [#8024](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8024)).
- **Studio Server:** Audio decodes are bounded, stop when nobody waits, and their cache is capped ([5f6995fe7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5f6995fe77c038cb97a9b9474785f5e36812d061), [#7991](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7991)).
- **Studio:** A modal opened from a popover or menu closes first on Escape ([c8235f123](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c8235f123524584e86e90a6818ad1692f993e62e), [#7976](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7976)).
- **Engine:** GPU probe, HDR capture and host-ceiling probe keep a required sandbox ([fb5f9e52c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fb5f9e52ceab03847fba56e60a34bdbb70b43369), [#8018](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8018)).
- **CLI:** Render --docker applies the received-project rule on the host ([e58fb3249](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e58fb3249b9d74dbe9997d4020e50680ba36a061), [#8016](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8016)).
- **Studio:** An undo on a sealed preview shows in place, not after a reload ([fee03bfbe](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fee03bfbe1ed5380762ca67f41366f216fb08a95), [#8009](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8009)).
- **CLI:** Files from outside the project are uploaded only once approved ([22b615f1a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/22b615f1a7f1e28cd579d0fb7591c74272cc4485), [#7995](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7995)).
- **CLI:** Compare and keyframes --shot serve only the files a bare HTML file names ([346579b6b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/346579b6b9bfb2959a931dd37282d8c4f67ce784), [#8006](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8006)).
- Preview image prep reads no HEIC or GIF outside the project unless render would ([f880693cf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f880693cf18b9727a3a9b45eeea6a7a865fa004a), [#8001](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8001)).
- **Engine:** The playlist folder check reads colon, query and fragment names as ffmpeg resolves them ([38aaad1b2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/38aaad1b2061aa565a0609d2faad837f978130d1), [#8014](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8014)).
- **Studio Server:** Bound preview stills and keep proxy work to the Studio's own pages ([bffe8d598](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bffe8d5985f751c708d1ca3996f9b3e037f5d9b4), [#8007](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8007)).
- **Producer:** Local renders leave out scripts from outside the project unless included ([581a43bb6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/581a43bb6a23e991ec0162714a1155226d12df65), [#7998](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7998)).
- **CLI:** Only the Studio's own origin may frame the Studio page ([02c1fb48e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/02c1fb48e7d8d89efa3746e6f3b0ea16027753e0), [#8000](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8000)).
- **Producer:** Linear probe media check, and renders refuse composition HTML over 16 MB ([d53b6059b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d53b6059bdc0e2a14027f179fa0cf08e2d5ddb51), [#7992](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7992)).
- **Studio Server:** History writes and claims follow Studio's write rule ([32fe10a8b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/32fe10a8b3d33e39bf540d17dc4fe551e2d152a9), [#7988](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7988)).
- **CLI:** Error boxes and command failure lines print control characters as visible escapes ([5979991d5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5979991d5f0af542fbb02ba906bdba4de52b2b64), [#7987](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7987)).

## Internal

- **Publish:** A stable release needs a maintainer's approval, not any account's ([4807799c4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4807799c4e4e1a824621155e38b28e4808283423), [#8062](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8062)).
- Raise the producer packed-size budget to 936,000 bytes ([909a9b183](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/909a9b183c8b7f47722ff59b05ffc02edca65356), [#8054](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8054)).

- **Publish:** A prerelease tag publishes only to an allow-listed dist-tag ([9fae4ffd8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9fae4ffd81da46b5a21e6540f2d45bce8e074307), [#7963](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7963)).

name: v0.9.59
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.59

Released on 2026-11-16.

The preview player gets a fullscreen button, and a failed render now says why. Renders, Studio and the CLI keep to the project's own files and to public media hosts.

## Features

- **CLI:** Diff --hide scores a project's layer by what it adds ([e6d5c699b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e6d5c699b18d4f1c6cc9d22227b1f1c3e1fd43f3), [#7972](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7972)).
- **Player:** Add a fullscreen button to the preview player ([5be6c1580](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5be6c1580f6e707966818ab15c349ea31814f69e), [#7726](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7726)).
- **Core:** Describe replies carry the picker's element label, and studio exports standInHandle ([51ae92510](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/51ae92510502dae5255f997058e9a5dfa399ad77), [#7936](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7936)).

## Fixes

- Hidden and credential files stay out of Studio, history and lint ([c68c78445](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c68c78445d95914b527490b580a80dd076f78d13), [#7979](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7979)).
- **Core:** A page marked for another site gives that site only playback ([c4d607c7f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c4d607c7f866c61c1dce18c2edd84e9b4c2c9f34), [#7980](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7980)).
- **Studio Server:** No write route touches files other tools run or trust ([2a28e4368](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2a28e43685c6aaf53c215a77b123fc4f9ecbaa33), [#7964](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7964)).
- **CLI:** The skills update check never reads a project's git config ([e368db138](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e368db138f343e90324801c2c78c6c4baa6420be), [#7975](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7975)).
- **Lint:** Run Studio and producer lint off the host's own thread ([778a00564](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/778a005641db50f2f37ef8d40cf813c58a30cee4), [#7974](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7974)).
- **Producer:** Probe sub-composition media defaults ([95e4e7f88](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/95e4e7f880f5005211412e926b307f4a53f47246), [#7550](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7550)).

# HyperFrames v0.9.58

Released on 2026-11-16.

Studio exports a sealed preview's checked element reads and stand-ins, and renders, carve and the audio engine keep to the project's own files. This release also carries everything prepared as v0.9.57, which never reached npm.

## Features

- **Studio:** A sealed preview frame forwards Studio's playback keys ([b741ecf13](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b741ecf1320ebad92f3a74b1e87a50a326c84db4), [#7844](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7844)).
- **CLI:** Show and open the page to manage or cancel a paid plan ([b2e6076b7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b2e6076b7e7f73debadd1ac91a5b64ea2c4d3ae0), [#7784](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7784)).

name: v2.1.0 - Global skills
body:
# OpenSpec 2.1

OpenSpec now supports global skills for coding agents. Install the skills once and your agent can use them in every project on your machine.

As more teams adopt Vercel’s `skills` installer, it’s becoming a common way to install skills across coding tools. OpenSpec is adopting it too, so we can spend less time maintaining installer code and more time improving the skills themselves.

The OpenSpec workflows themselves haven't changed.

## What changed

- **Skills can be installed globally.** Vercel’s installer handles the location for each supported agent, whether it reads `~/.agents/skills/` or uses its own folder.
- **`openspec update` asks where a project's skills should live.** In a repo that has its own OpenSpec skills, you choose once between keeping them in the repo and switching to global. Nothing changes until you choose.
- **`openspec init --tools <ids>` in a new repo installs globally.** In 2.0 it wrote the skills into the repo. Add `--scope project` to keep them there.
- **Skills are installed by Vercel’s `skills` package.** Installing or refreshing them needs Git and access to GitHub.

## How to upgrade

Update the OpenSpec CLI, then run this in each project:

```bash
openspec update
```

In a repo that has its own OpenSpec skills, you'll see this choice:

```text
Where should OpenSpec keep this project’s skills?

❯ Keep in this project   Keep the skills in this repo.
  Switch to global       Install the skills globally, for every project on this machine.
```

**Keep in this project.** Press Enter. The skills stay in your repo. Commit `openspec/config.yaml`, which records your choice so your teammates aren’t asked. Choose this if GitHub’s hosted Copilot agent reads the skills from the repo. You can switch later with `openspec init --scope global`.

**Switch to global.** We recommend this for most teams. The skills are installed globally on your machine, and the copies in the repo are removed. Commit the removed files. Each teammate then pulls, runs `openspec update`, and answers **Yes** when it offers to set up skills on their machine. Upgrade everyone’s CLI before you switch a repo: earlier versions only know project skills.

In CI or from an agent there is no question: update refreshes the skills where they are.

**If a script sets up your repos,** add `--scope project` to keep new repos' skills in the repo:

```bash
openspec init --scope project --tools claude
```

**Note:** `openspec update` replaces the built-in skill folders. If you edited a built-in skill or added a file inside one, save it first. `openspec update --dry-run` shows what will change.

An npm install needs Node 22.20.0 or newer. The standalone executable needs nothing. If you already ran `npx skills add`, keep that install and run `openspec update`.

See the [upgrade guide](https://openspec.dev/docs/upgrade-2-1) for more details.

## Fixes

- The Windows executables are now labeled as OpenSpec, published by FISSION AI INC. Their file properties used to name the build tool, and an antivirus product removed `openspec.exe` as a threat. If the download disappears or won't run, the installer now says antivirus is the likely cause and shows the npm install command.

**Full changelog:** [v2.0.0...v2.1.0](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/compare/v2.0.0...v2.1.0)

name: v18.22.0
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Fixed

- Fixed slow streaming of Gemma tool calls with large arguments.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Breaking Changes

- Moved binary analysis from the standalone `ida` and `ghidra` tools into the backend-neutral `dsm` namespace (`xd://eval/dsm`).
- Replaced the `ida.enabled`, `ida.maxOpen`, and `ida.idleCloseSec` settings with `disassembler.backend`, `disassembler.maxOpen`, and `disassembler.idleCloseSec`; shared disassembler database APIs are now available under `@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent/disasm`.

### Added

- Added Tern plan review editing and comments: double-click plans to edit them, select text to add Google Docs-style comments, and send comments to Refine.
- Added Ghidra support with automatic setup of Ghidra, JDK, and PyGhidra when analysis is explicitly requested; Auto mode uses an installed IDA Pro when available and otherwise falls back to Ghidra.
- Added support for sharing live analysis databases with child agents through `db.handle()` and `dsm.open(handle)`.
- Added a `Force Remove` option to `worktree.onExit` that removes session-created worktrees without prompting, including worktrees with uncommitted changes; new commits remain on the worktree branch.

### Changed

- Updated Tern plan review with a single Approve control, comment-aware Refine option, model selection, and a Save action that writes the plan while keeping review open and plan mode active.
- Plain executable reads now display Mach-O, ELF, and PE metadata without opening an analysis database or downloading a backend; request an overview, function details, or `dsm.open()` to begin analysis.
- Improved the model switcher (`Alt+P` / `/switch`) with provider filtering and per-switch thinking-level selection. In Tern, it now opens above the composer with integrated search, provider and Task/Main filters, and a thinking-level slider.

### Fixed

- Deleting or moving large directory trees inside a project no longer stalls language-server file watching ([#19490](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19490) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC)).
- Reduced CPU and memory usage for long-running subagents as their sessions grow ([#19486](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19486) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC)).
- Fixed `commit.draft()` incorrectly classifying files deleted or renamed through bash or eval as “Not yours”; they now appear under Review.

### Removed

- Removed the legacy standalone disassembler tools and their associated prompt instructions.
- Removed the Copy and Edit-in-editor buttons from the Tern plan review sheet; use selection copying and double-click editing instead.

## @oh-my-pi/collab-web

### Fixed

- Improved streaming performance in the collab viewer, preventing long replies from becoming progressively slower as they are received.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Breaking Changes

- `TtyWriter` now requires a drain threshold and callback and only supports independently reopenable TTYs. Its pending UTF-8 byte bounds are reported conservatively.

### Changed

- Large terminal repaints are handled more efficiently, reducing JavaScript-thread work and releasing oversized buffers after output drains.

### Fixed

- Fixed stalled terminal writers continuing to emit output or leaking file descriptors after shutdown.
- Fixed terminal output preserving Unicode across chunk boundaries and safely replacing malformed surrogate sequences.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Breaking Changes

- Terminals that support output backpressure must now implement onOutputDrain(callback), which returns an unsubscribe function; terminals without backpressure can omit both pendingOutputBytes and onOutputDrain.
- Updated PlanReviewOverlay options to use PlanReviewOverlayChoice objects and report choice IDs to onPick and selectOption. Refine and Save actions now reflect plan feedback and saving behavior; removed disabledIndices and externalEditorName, and updated describe to receive DescribeContext.

### Added

- Added configurable model search placement, provider scopes, and an optional thinking-level slider to ModelPickerComponent; selected thinking levels are reported through onPick metadata. The native picker sheet now supports anchoring, scope styling, level display, and icon actions.
- Added a native plan review document and dock with editable and commentable plans, quote annotations, plan-edit notifications, Approve, Save, and Cancel actions, plus model selection.

### Changed

- Provider scopes now show only the selected provider's models when a provider is chosen, with scope cycling able to return to the full model list.
- Updated thinking-level controls to use left and right arrow keys, and refreshed the slider and footer hint presentation.
- Retitled the plan-saving overlay to “Save plan” and updated its action label.

### Fixed

- Fixed slow scrolling and typing in long agent transcripts.
- Fixed slow typing and cursor movement in drafts longer than 256 lines.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-wire

### Added

- Added optional picker icons for tooltips and accessible names, plus an option to control the placement of the search interface.
- Added buttons, menu, and document component kinds, including menu-row action state changes and document text editing, commenting, and uncommenting events.


## What's Changed
* perf(coding-agent): stop copying the full message list and journal per publisher flush by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19486
* perf(tui): stop editor wrap-cache thrash and full visual-line rebuilds by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19488
* perf(ai): scan Gemma in-band tool calls incrementally by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19487
* perf(coding-agent): forget vanished directories in the LSP file watcher without full scans by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19490
* perf(collab-web): keep finished Markdown blocks' DOM while streaming by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19485
* perf(tui): reuse the agent transcript viewer's rows between paints by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19489


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/compare/v18.21.0...v18.22.0

name: v18.21.0
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Added

- Added automatic detection of thinking capabilities for previously unknown models, with persistent results and support for alternate effort and token-budget request formats.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added Modal as a hosted inference provider.

### Changed

- Changed the local speech model from Kokoro to Phonon 31M.
- Improved reasoning capability detection by preserving unverified thinking-level support and using endpoint-specific probe results when available.

### Fixed

- Fixed xAI Grok OAuth model grok-composer-2.5-fast being incorrectly identified as non-reasoning; it now supports thinking levels from minimal through xhigh.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Breaking Changes

- Updated the `AgentSession` run lifecycle API: `agent_end` is emitted once when a run can no longer resume, and `agent_pause` reports runs that stop while awaiting work. Replaced `hasPendingAsyncWork()`, `settleAsyncWork()`, and `suppressAutoResumeUntilPrompt()` with `isRunActive`, `wakeSources`, and `waitForRunEnd()`. Calling `abort()` now also ends runs paused on background work; RPC, JSON print, collaboration, and extension streams retain their existing per-loop `agent_end` behavior.

### Added

- Added configurable automatic subagent prewalk through `task.agentPrewalkAuto`, allowing per-agent `on`/`off` settings or model patterns while preserving unconditional subagent prewalk.
- Unknown custom and discovered models now automatically detect reasoning support and remember supported reasoning effort levels for future sessions.
- Added inline image and web-page replies: supported terminals can display local, data, and HTTP(S) images and embedded pages, while other terminals receive linked fallbacks. Added `tui.renderEmbeds` to disable this rendering.
- Added interactive embedded pages in Tern replies, including click-to-visit and Escape-to-return navigation; common host, path, and `file:` URL forms are accepted.
- Bash redirects can now write to all writable internal URLs, including job cancellation endpoints and handler-backed `agent://`, `cfg://`, `ssh://`, and `xd://` URLs.
- Added image pasting to `ask` form notes and `ui.formDialog` options via `acceptImages`; pasted images are returned with `[Image #N]` markers and described for text-only models. Unsupported prompts now clearly reject image pastes.

### Changed

- Changed the default local text-to-speech model to Phonon 31M for faster synthesis, smaller downloads, and additional voices. Existing Kokoro voice settings migrate automatically; speaking rates now range from 0.8× to 1.3×.
- Tern `/btw` responses now appear as folded, interactive notes at the point where they were requested, with follow-up, copy, branch, inject, and stop actions; `/btw` without a prompt still opens the history view.
- Overlapping Bash calls now share shell state, including variables, functions, aliases, options, and traps, and background jobs started by those calls continue running independently.
- Extensions enabled or reconfigured through `extensions` or `disabledExtensions` now load into the active session without requiring a restart.
- Rich-text pastes made during approval steering or in dialogs now preserve Markdown formatting and images when inserted into the chat editor.
- Moving a task or resuming a session in another project now switches its agents, extensions, custom tools, and MCP servers to match the destination project without a restart.

### Fixed

- Fixed status indicators incorrectly showing the agent as idle while subagents or background work could still resume the run.
- Fixed subagents and security scans completing while child agents were still running or queued peer messages remained.
- Fixed conflict-region resolution when a selected side is empty or shares edge lines with surrounding code.
- MCP stdio server failures before a response now report the process exit code or terminating signal instead of only reporting closed stdout.
- Fixed prewalk handoffs so model and reasoning-effort changes are preserved, and automatic handoffs return to the planning model when automatic prewalk is changed or disabled.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

### Changed

- Improved file memory bank performance by reducing unnecessary disk synchronization during checkpointing, lowering per-turn I/O overhead for banks shared across multiple processes.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Added

- Added the `PhononTts` binding for on-device Phonon text-to-speech.
- Added `Shell.adopt(fork)` to apply variables, functions, aliases, options, and traps from a completed fork back to its parent shell. When both shells set a name, the value from the command that finished last is retained.

### Fixed

- Fixed concurrent `commitCreate()` calls incorrectly overwriting each other’s commit subject and body.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- Added support for pasting images into `HtmlFormDialog` option notes when opened with `acceptImages`, including image attachment, removal, and access to retained images through `OptionNote.images`.
- Added live web-page and image rendering in assistant replies for supported terminals, including inline images and embedded page previews. Added the `/btw` transcript note for sharing side topics without interrupting the main conversation.

### Changed

- Improved reasoning-capability discovery so models awaiting discovery follow the session's thinking default and offer automatic thinking in addition to disabled and effort-level settings.
- Renamed the public `html-form/media` APIs to `media`, including `loadMedia`, `Media`, and `MAX_MEDIA_BYTES`.

### Fixed

- Fixed fallback model selection so roles are offered only models they can use, excluding incompatible image and speech models.
- Fixed macOS spelling assistance, autocorrect, replacements, and word completion for shell (`!`) and Python (`$`) drafts.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Fixed

- Fixed bare URLs swallowing the following word when Korean, Japanese, or Chinese text follows a parenthesized URL without a space.


## What's Changed
* add modal as a hosted inference provider by @andrewhinh in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18785
* feat(task): add task.agentPrewalkAuto to judge subagent prewalk per assignment by @1vivy in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18913
* fix(coding-agent): rescope agents, extensions, custom tools and MCP servers on /move by @yuzu-octopus in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19416
* fix(tui): disable macOS spelling assistance for local-execution drafts by @aleister1102 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12474
* fix(mcp): report the stdio subprocess exit status on EOF by @adi-IL in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16482
* fix(utils): end bare URLs at an unbalanced ) before CJK text by @nnnnoel in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19336
* fix(vcs): isolate commit message files between concurrent commits by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19345
* fix(tui): filter model hub fallback picks by the role's accepted kinds by @Xytronix in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19371
* fix(coding-agent): keep image pastes in dialogs out of the hidden chat editor by @Dangerboi in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19374
* feat(coding-agent): let ask option notes take pasted screenshots again by @Dangerboi in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/19376
* fix(coding-agent): honor explicit choices during prewalk handoff by @taibenvenuti in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17292

name: v0.22.9
body:
# oh-my-codex v0.22.9

## Summary

This minor release ships updated code-review skill with source-bound continuation and repair receipts. Review receipts now capture and preserve source identity (commit hash, uncommitted changes, file hashes), track scope, requirements, gates, and validation results independently for each review lane, and enforce invalidation rules preventing unverifiable approval of changed source or invalidated evidence.

## Added

- **CODE-REVIEW SKILL: SOURCE-BOUND CONTINUATION AND REPAIR RECEIPTS (#4098):** The code-review skill now captures source identity in review receipts, distinguishes review operation contexts (fresh review, missing-lane resumption, missing-validation collection, repair re-review, complete evidence termination), and prevents receipt reuse when source, requirements, gates, or validation change. Receipt-based invalidation rules ensure continuation always operates on verified scope and that repair re-review never substitutes lane results. First review runs both lanes in parallel on clean contexts; continuation never drops lanes. Standalone review stays read-only. Fixes #4095.

## Compatibility

No breaking API changes. Release-coupled metadata (`package.json`, `package-lock.json`, Cargo workspace, and plugin metadata) all report `0.22.9`.

This beta adds separately opted-in automatic error reports, so failures can reach the maintainers without a manual bug report. Reports stay off unless you allow them, and never include audio, text, files, names, credentials or logs.

**Highlights**

- Optional automatic error reports stay off until separately allowed in Privacy
- Android Stories and Audiobook keep long manuscripts scrollable and recover drafts through activity recreation
- Stories can merge adjacent lines with compatible speaker and voice settings
- Linux ROCm setup preserves its installed PyTorch stack, and GPU readiness reflects failed self-tests
- Phone dub exports check available space and avoid false low-space errors on iOS

**Upgrading:** install over the existing app or use Settings → Updates → Beta. Voices, projects, settings and installed models stay in place.

### Changed

- Removed an unused legacy update-busy helper while retaining active restart protection (#4149) — thanks @themrbeasley!
- Retired an unused legacy update toast while preserving the active Electron update controls (#4141) — thanks @themrbeasley!
- Retired the unreachable legacy shared UI and the guard tests that held it, repointing the live-behaviour guards to the renderer, and dropped 12 unused npm packages (#4095)
- Smaller install: removed unused leftover images and old helper code from the app source (#4087)
- Projects grid view stays smooth with thousands of items by drawing only the cards in view (#4079)
- Long Projects, dub project and Transcribe history lists now render only the rows on screen, so they stay fast with thousands of items (#4074)
- Idle CPU: a hidden or minimised window no longer runs polling timers or elapsed-time clocks, and they refresh once when it is shown again (#4073)
- Removed unused renderer files and 477 unused translation strings, and `locale:check` now fails on an English key no code uses (#4047)
- Removed more unused legacy shared components, utilities and API helpers from the old shared UI folder (#4045)
- Local-model folder saves no longer unload the engine when the stored folder did not change (#4043)
- Removed more unused legacy settings, gallery and engine screens from the old shared UI folder (#4042)
- Idle polling is relaxed: the backend health probe slows when steady, cloud-sync polling pauses while the window is hidden, and the Windows parent watcher polls less often (#4041)
- Removed more unused legacy dubbing screens and hooks from the old shared UI folder (#4040)
- Release notes now open with one Download table listing every desktop and phone download with its signing, followed by the Highlights (#4037)
- Removed about 25,000 lines of unused legacy interface code, two unused font packages and the always-skipped weekly evals job; the app itself is unchanged (#2603, #4032)

### Added

- Stories can merge adjacent lines with the same speaker and compatible voice/speed settings while preserving text and inline directions — thanks [cvak on Discord](https://discord.com/channels/1497926884707799144/1497926886020354102/1566929293853073429)! (#4161)
- Added separately opted-in failure reporting through Supermetry app intake across desktop, mobile and server installs, with private metadata and consent-controlled retries (#4137)
- Dubbing exports the selected transcript as plain UTF-8 TXT, including edited text before generating a dub, with native Save As and paired phone sharing. (#4155) — thanks @shivamdhiman999111-source!
- A dub interrupted by a crash or restart now picks up from its finished segments instead of starting over (#4088)
- omnivoice-gguf now supports voice design, non-verbal tags and the decode-steps slider (#4084) — thanks @snazzybean!
- Cebuano is now a dub translation target (#4058, #4072) — thanks @onparr-24!
- Home shows a What's new link, winter pixel snow, a Christmas-week Santa, two rows of contributor portraits, and an easter egg that hides the credits until the next update after you visit three contributor profiles (#4070)
- Voice Cloning has a generation queue: takes started while one is rendering wait their turn and run one after another — thanks @ItzSudhan! (#4064)
- Audiobooks and Stories have a New project button that starts an empty draft without touching saved projects (#4055)

### Docs

- The localization contract no longer exempts the removed legacy shared i18n catalog, which pointed reviewers at a path that does not exist (#4186) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Document the enforced up-to-date merge gate while the repository cannot use GitHub merge queues (#4165)
- Track the unresolved VoxCPM2 installation report separately from GPU fallback fixes, reported by [vinhson](https://discord.com/users/1025270992882376704) (#4154)
- Track the unresolved Windows model-loading crash and distinguish merged installer repairs from released fixes (#4146) — thanks @renaldyramadani123-code!
- Installation tracking separates shipped fixes, pending repairs and unresolved report evidence (#4121)
- Document host-managed Tailscale access for Docker without sharing the host daemon socket (#4111) — thanks @MaverickKB!

### Fixed

- Desktop failure observers retain the original consent during backend restarts and preserve normal Promise behavior. (#4209)
- CosyVoice catalogue downloads skip unused alternative model files and use the same required assets as managed installs. (#4207)
- Android keeps large manuscripts editable and recoverable, and retains reporting consent through permission prompts. (#4206) — thanks @gaino-svg!
- The closed-PR CI sweep requests cancellations incrementally, preserves partial progress and reports incomplete searches or skipped requests accurately (#4189) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Kept automatic error reports bound to original consent through delayed work and recovery, and preserved native CI verification (#4184) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Windows ROCm setup preserves working-install stamps, verifies the pinned interpreter, and reports native crash exit codes (#4182) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Windows checkouts no longer fail the CLI packaging tests: the Debian maintainer-script cases skip when the host has no POSIX shell or symlink privileges (#4178) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Phone dubbing clip/stem exports check output space on both platforms and avoid false low-space errors on iOS (#4168)
- Linux ROCm setup skips CUDA downloads and preserves its installed PyTorch stack on resume (#4167) — thanks @khryztiam!
- GPU readiness and in-process routing reflect completed self-test failures (#4166) — thanks @khryztiam!
- CLA audits keep exempt accounts visible for provenance review without reporting a missing required signature (#4164)
- Release rehearsals show measured Android APK signing, and tagged downloads require matching signature evidence (#4163)
- Manual Windows crash reports retain the faulting thread ahead of verbose status tails — thanks @renaldyramadani123-code and @freemood36-svg! (#4162)
- macOS publishing checks Gatekeeper even when Windows installers are explicitly unsigned (#4153)
- The reviewed model-install steps now require the same authenticated consumer as the rest of the model manager (#4152) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Diagnostic bundles and Electron bug reports redact share PINs and encoded credential query parameters (#4151) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Make the installed-model licence action open its terms and acknowledgement dialog — thanks [hugotriunfa18 on Discord](https://discord.com/users/1571221621316784260)! (#4147)
- Android model downloads resume through VPNs while preserving Wi-Fi policy and saved ranges (#4140) — thanks @JerryTimi!
- Stopped playback errors from incorrectly claiming that generated audio files are missing (#4138) — thanks @AAYUSH-CODER1904!
- Transcriptions can save clean plain text and timed SRT captions, with an explanation when subtitle timings are unavailable (#4135)
- Cloud sign-in now rejects a discovery document whose token or revocation endpoint is not on the issuer's own origin (#4133) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Segmented model downloads pin public destinations with bounded DNS checks across redirects, ranges and proxies, preventing private-network fallback and CDN credential leaks (#4132) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- The LM Studio model probe no longer sends the stored API key in clear text to a remote host unless plaintext LAN is allowed (#4131) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- A deterministic test now fails when a new mutating API route ships without an authorization decision (#4130) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Docker deployments now require the administrator API key for the runtime log, log stream, recent errors and crash report, as the install docs already said (#4129) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- MCP tools preserve remote caller permissions across local and HTTP backends, including failed transport lookups (#4128) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- TTS and event WebSockets now enforce the same loopback/credential rule as dictation, closing a share-PIN bypass (#4126) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Imported project bundles can no longer make ffmpeg fetch remote URLs through a playlist-shaped media file (#4125) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Deleting history, rewriting dub scripts and clearing model-licence receipts now require an administrator, as the API docs already promised (#4124) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- SoniTranslate installation and start/stop now require a local administrator, like every other engine installer (#4123) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Model deletion over the API now requires administrator rights (#4122) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Crash recurrence reports recognize current Electron version fields and distinguish beta releases (#4120)
- Reclaim idle GPU models before generation when VRAM or RAM is low (#4117) — thanks @vandyahmad24!
- Model downloads reject damaged files and retry without reusing corrupt ranges, while cancellation preserves verified work (#4116)
- Reuse verified setup wheels on low-space retries and handle interrupted size probes without an uncaught error. (#4115)
- Saved and inline pronunciation choices apply consistently across speech, dubbing, batch and voice-conversion routes (#4114) — thanks @nntloc!
- Stop cancelled setup retries promptly and keep verbose runtime probes from blocking on their diagnostic output. (#4113)
- Long recordings use duration-scaled transcription limits across uploads, dubbing, child engines and MCP tools (#4112) — thanks @xabiherdz-svg!
- URL imports restore their connection guard after temporary DNS resolver changes (#4110)
- Update the optional Dagger pipeline's OpenTelemetry dependencies to fix excessive CPU use when parsing malformed trace context. (#4109)
- Optional analytics no longer delays backend readiness, and consent changes invalidate queued startup work (#4108) — thanks @cf3901646!
- Auto setup can retry PyPI failures through the regional mirror and report the actual failed host (#4107) — thanks @mrkeshi!
- Malformed model-install status responses keep the interface open and preserve the last valid download state (#4106) — thanks @ftlcustomerservice73-ui!
- Windows installer process checks skip custom PowerShell profiles, and source installs use shorter build paths to avoid MSVC linker failures (#4099)
- Restarting to install an update keeps update status available while the local engine shuts down, avoiding missing-handler errors (#4098)
- Automatic blank-renderer recovery keeps the open workspace instead of returning Stories or Audiobook to Home (#4097)
- Dubbing keeps the saved recording for cloned and designed voices with style instructions, so each segment uses the selected speaker's reference (#4093)
- Setup on Auto-detect now retries a stalled Python download (`cpython-… (download)`) once from the other source, GitHub or its mirror, instead of stalling again (#4085)
- A refused cross-site API request now names its origin and gives the exact `OMNIVOICE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` line to add, so other local apps such as AIRI can be connected (#4083)
- Setup no longer crashes with "Cannot set property code" when a runtime download or check is cancelled on Windows (#4082)
- MOSS-TTS-Nano speaks again on a fresh one-click install: the transformers 5 shim no longer breaks model loads in its pinned transformers 4 environment (#4063, #4078) — thanks @RerankerGuo, and @rockziepromax for the report!
- OmniVoice GGUF falls back to the CPU when the GPU backend crashes, for example Vulkan on a GTX 1080 (#4050, #4072) — thanks @MeinLive!
- Full dubs no longer fail when translation fills segments with free-text directions like "slow"; unsupported ones are dropped for that segment (#4054, #4072) — thanks @user555gtb!
- Audiobook MP3 exports play and download again instead of returning 404 (#4071, #4072) — thanks @dimfk001git!
- Colab: setup cells show the failing command's output, the security-floor check judges the Mako copy Python imports, and the web UI loads through the new `*.prod.r.colab.dev` proxy — thanks @hkarmoush! (#4069)
- Turning on LAN sharing no longer crashes the backend with an Internal Server Error — thanks @blutuxyz! (#4059)
- The OmniVoice GGUF engine finds its bundled runtime again in installed apps instead of reporting it missing — thanks @b84330808! (#4053)
- When the operating system times out starting the engine (`spawn ETIMEDOUT`, seen on macOS), VoiceStudio retries twice and then says to restart the computer (#4039)
- Settings → Updates lists only your channel's releases, and Beta suggests switching to Stable when a newer stable is out (#4038)
- SSML `[spell]` keeps flag, ZWJ-joined and skin-tone emoji whole instead of splitting them (#4020) — thanks @kevin9327!

### CI

- CI reuses unchanged iOS checks, rechecks shared diagnostic inputs and skips Nix builds for documentation and test changes. (#4208)
- Windows release and optional-engine tests use portable text fixtures, native Bash and normalized cache paths (#4197) — thanks @swax!
- Release builds load app-intake credentials from GitHub Actions Secrets without public-variable fallbacks (#4204, #4205)
- Fixed Android screenshot capture waiting behind the optional error-report prompt (#4202) — thanks @velixio!
- Keep iOS voice-search and download checks reliable across saved model choices (#4171)
- The iPhone smoke test waits for typed text to reach the editor instead of reading it once, removing a CI flake (#4100)
- MOSS compatibility tests keep checking the active Transformers version after another test restores imported modules (#4096)
- The iPhone UI smoke test keeps its slow-inventory case loading for the whole test, so a slow simulator no longer fails it (#4076)
- Docker's web build no longer fails the unused-key check when only `electron/` is copied, and the iPhone CI job allows for a native-runtime cache miss (#4052)
- Removed unused scripts, the old Tauri MSI tooling and leftover Turborepo ignore lines (#4046)
- Accessibility smoke timeouts now name the requests still pending, so a flaky CI failure points at its cause (#4036)

### Bug reporters

- @gaino-svg — long Android manuscripts (#4201)
- @renaldyramadani123-code and @freemood36-svg — native-crash evidence that improved manual reports; the underlying Windows crash remains unresolved (#4142, #4158, #4162)
- @rockziepromax — MOSS-TTS-Nano voice cloning (#4063)
- @MeinLive — GGUF GPU crashes and the relocated runtime lookup (#4050, #4051)
- @user555gtb — directions that interrupted full dubs (#4054)
- @dimfk001git — audiobook MP3 playback and downloads (#4071)
- [hugotriunfa18 on Discord](https://discord.com/channels/1497926884707799144/1571229026138325102/1571229026138325102) — the installed-model licence action (#4143)
- [vinhson on Discord](https://discord.com/channels/1497926884707799144/1567177140007608350/1567177140007608350) — VoxCPM2 installation evidence retained in the tracker; this report remains unresolved (#4154)

### Contributors

New since v0.5.9-beta.3: @debpalash, @velixio, @DeryFerd, @swax

Everyone who contributed since v0.5.8: @debpalash, @DeryFerd, @velixio, @ItzSudhan, @b84330808, @blutuxyz, @kevin9327, @RerankerGuo, @hkarmoush, @swax, @vandyahmad24

name: openclaw 2026.11.5
body:
## 2026.11.5

### Highlights

- **Restart-safe conversations:** Queued messages, send permissions, and final chat writes are retained across Gateway restarts. (#196923, #196540, #196493) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @joshavant.
- **Safer updates:** Failed Doctor or Gateway startup rolls back an activated update, while restored npm packages remain readable by non-root services. (#197851, #193272) Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, and @vincentkoc.
- **Telegram widgets:** Interactive widgets now render in Telegram messages, including private-chat topics. (#196991, #198022). Related #197923 Thanks @obviyus and @dankarization.
- **Faster memory recovery:** Large memory-index rebuilds finish reliably, and embedding indexing recovers when a gateway truncates a batch-limit error. (#196378, #187797). Related #187788 Thanks @TameTheGame, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @garrytan, @obviyus, and @fredtanxo.
- **More reliable model fallback:** A configured primary account no longer blocks Claude CLI fallback, and OpenAI sessions recover from compaction item conflicts. (#198427, #198357). Related #158421 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @alkor2000, and @HerbertHuerto.
- **Usable device folders:** Existing device folders remain selectable with the default runtime, and each folder choice gets a clear, compact menu row. (#190065, #190088) Thanks @RomneyDa and @obviyus.
- **Content boundaries:** Binary attachments no longer become garbled prompt text, and authenticated browser CDP URLs stay out of tool results. (#198309, #196262). Related #198289 Thanks @Yun-0000, @obviyus, @mulderp82, @PollyBot13, and @sallyom.

### Changes

- **Busy-session messages and security presets:** Personal-mode messages steer compatible work or queue quietly instead of requiring a manual resend. The personal and corporate security presets provide coherent defaults; explicit settings and mandatory access/approval limits still apply. (#185477) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @joshavant.
- **Compaction:** Set maxSummaryChars to control the summary character cap. (#196207). Related #194408 Thanks @aniruddhaadak80, @RomneyDa, and @garrytan.
- **Knowledge:** Keep pages within a read-sized budget and extract sections without loading an oversized page. (#186270) Thanks @jalehman.
- **Breaking: harness and plugin session control:** Third-party harnesses must register session-keyed active runs inside the host runAttempt callback and retain the returned cleanup function. Plugin RPC handlers must replace chatAbortControllers/chatQueuedTurns with authorized Gateway method dispatch. Start-owner observations use startDeadlineAtMs instead of expiresAtMs; bundled consumers are migrated. (#175837) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @jalehman.

### Fixes

- **Authorization:** Queued automation runs recheck access to owner-private memory before starting, and failed child results remain deliverable after the parent turn ends. (#198697, #197658). Related #198695 Thanks @RomneyDa, @daniel-lxs, and @obviyus.
- **Conversation history:** Refreshes retain keyed commentary, transcript reads survive concurrent database preparation, and completed empty attempts no longer clutter history. (#188180, #188055, #188111) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @fuller-stack-dev, and @jalehman.
- **Gateway recovery:** Resume interrupted turns after workspace preparation, preserve graceful shutdown when restart intent stalls, and acknowledge uploads before workspace preparation. (#196423, #188047, #188728) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @TameTheGame, and @vincentkoc.
- **Gateway reload:** Configuration updates no longer hang when the file watcher wins the reload race; MCP listener work is cancelled when shutdown starts. (#192701, #197119) Thanks @RomneyDa, @zeroaltitude, and @obviyus.
- **Cron scheduling:** Preserve scheduled account selection, restart retry deadlines and completion-run identity; handle late scheduler wakeups without silently dropping jobs. (#180677, #197449, #197484) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @giodl73-repo, @Stronggenetics, and @obviyus.
- **Cron lifecycle:** Configuration hot reload no longer aborts in-flight jobs; startup deadlines and cancellation remain effective, and disabled automatic scheduling releases idle workers. (#197606, #188982, #196387). Related #197591 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @obviyus, and @wupingyuan81-oss.
- **Quiet automations:** False trigger checks stay out of chat, and main-session automations can run from a DM without failing before the model call. (#188594, #188700, #180603). Related #180602, #197181 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, and @Suiah98.
- **Telegram replies and approvals:** Restore ACP replies in progress-stream mode and keep approvals inside their private or forum topic. (#197191, #198038, #192162). Related #195899, #197907, #125166 Thanks @bach205, @obviyus, @dankarization, @claxman, and @Waste2Time.
- **Telegram hooks and controls:** Supply the runtime session key to delivery hooks and render disabled buttons as non-interactive. (#197519, #191647). Related #197186, #197669, #191645 Thanks @lester076, @obviyus, @rodricksz4h5, @tommyjoseph, and @aspalagin.
- **Channels:** Deliver captioned Feishu media with block streaming disabled, normalize Unicode directory matches in Matrix and Mattermost, and prevent crafted Matrix formatting from stalling mention checks. (#191585, #187881, #187199, #184432) Thanks @RomneyDa, @forrystudio, @xialonglee, @obviyus, @wangmiao0668000666, and @LeizhenZhang.
- **iOS voice:** Keep Talk working while the phone is locked and prevent the speech-permission Allow action from crashing the app. (#187864, #196822). Related #185664 Thanks @RomneyDa, @brianmcguire, @ultrakorne, and @obviyus.
- **Talk startup:** Voice requests no longer stall before the backing agent starts, and failed startup registrations are released. (#183586, #187840). Related #187838 Thanks @RomneyDa, @bdjben, @brokemac79, and @shakkernerd.
- **Control UI:** Prevent WebKit freezes while replacing an opening menu and avoid event-listener failures while chat details update. (#198658, #198380) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
- **Host desktop:** Finish VNC authentication during readiness probes so repeated checks do not trigger server lockouts. (#193487). Related #193444 Thanks @SebTardif, @obviyus, and @lakemike.
- **Keyboard and search:** Preserve IME navigation in the worktree picker, provide a keyboard skip to the composer, and match canonically equivalent Unicode attachment names. (#187732, #180896, #187674) Thanks @RomneyDa, @ooiuuii, @obviyus, @goutamadwant, @LiuwqGit, and @huwei-xydt.
- **UI responsiveness:** Avoid accumulated WebKit slowdown after repeated session switches; release static loading animations and settle aborted data-URL previews. (#194027, #194146, #191451) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @wangjx-xydt.
- **Provider continuity:** Keep provider checkpoints available across credential-source and model switches. (#200063, #200208) Thanks @obviyus.
- **OpenAI and Anthropic:** Preserve saved-context replay when hooks override requests, and keep Anthropic session prompts stable across completion wakes and message routes. (#199451, #197835, #197925) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @vyctorbrzezowski, and @obviyus.
- **Claude CLI and providers:** Recover after a failed live-session cleanup, reconnect after settled local transport failures, and include Claude CLI models without requiring an Anthropic model pin. (#198224, #187375, #191148). Related #195431, #187023 Thanks @obviyus, @mdarapour, @wtfichigo, @etzelm, and @Takhoffman.
- **Model discovery:** Avoid slow reads with large model configurations and recover provider discovery during concurrent SDK imports. (#198837, #196448). Related #195477 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @1052326311, and @WG-Mojo.
- **Provider routing:** Keep OpenRouter requests on their own endpoint; config writes no longer silently switch models to API-key billing. (#185294, #191326). Related #185272 Thanks @vishnusenthil-16, @obviyus, and @etzelm.
- **Rate limits:** Respect the configured maximum retry delay after tool execution instead of holding a session lane for an oversized wait. (#197611). Related #168101 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @kringsc.
- **Doctor and upgrades:** Bound Doctor startup waits, honor SIGTERM, and avoid stalling live sessions during hosted checks. (#187936, #191125) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
- **Update reliability:** Keep database restoration available while progress polls during Doctor, tolerate harmless empty-WAL transitions, preserve failed post-plugin Doctor warnings, and recognize successful Gateway startup before post-update checks. (#192083, #193134, #192942) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @TameTheGame, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @fuller-stack-dev.
- **macOS onboarding:** Preserve the installer terminal handoff so onboarding can install plugins without detached npm terminal failures. (#200247). Related #200244 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @miguelbranco80.
- **Stored state:** Restore cold transcripts for renamed agents before repair, tolerate retained deleted-agent databases, and isolate held databases until explicit restoration. (#196079, #198145, #198180). Related #196066 Authored by @steipete.
- **Backups:** Compact snapshots inside the staging directory, inspect the backup engine without copying the live database, and preserve SQLite corruption diagnostics. (#194230, #194234, #194497). Related #194208, #194209 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @GoatInAHat.
- **Backup diagnostics:** Identify busy files during backup capture and retry transient Windows access failures without weakening integrity checks. (#193685) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @wr-web.
- **Update recovery:** Handle state-path aliases, live cleanup writes and environment-only service overrides without losing restoration progress. (#189004, #189628, #196371) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Update cleanup:** Avoid false failures from leftover snapshot copies or NFS snapshot-directory cleanup, and preserve external plugin data during rehearsal. (#193702, #195409, #196301). Related #195396 Thanks @RomneyDa, @fuller-stack-dev, and @tianping.
- **Cold storage and startup:** Avoid worker out-of-memory failures during large transcript-index repair, restore cold PostgreSQL conversations after idle readers close, and avoid database-clone stalls during Gateway startup. (#194099, #189991, #190918) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @TameTheGame, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @etzelm, and @Frosmans.
- **Memory and SQLite:** Avoid redundant Dreaming inventory reads, release completed SQLite readers, and prevent cursor restarts. (#180692, #190242). Related #180657 Thanks @chelsealong, @obviyus, @lisandromachado, and @ava-perry.
- **Plugin rebuilds:** Release obsolete plugin-generation state instead of growing Gateway memory after every rebuild. (#199042) Thanks @etzelm and @Patrick-Erichsen.
- **Packages and discovery:** Ship PostgreSQL declarations, point packaged plugin exports at compiled runtime files, and restore Bonjour discovery in npm installs. (#188091, #188639, #199156) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @galiniliev, and @alfredjbclaw.
- **Browser and workflow paths:** Preserve native CORS preflights, avoid Lightpanda navigation timeouts, and keep literal workflow paths intact instead of trimming whitespace. (#185028, #196400, #187785) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @eleqtrizit, @wangmiao0668000666, and @obviyus.
- **CLI and configuration:** Offer help flags in shell completion, allow dotted-path insertions in JSON and YAML, and stop pending cron inventory reads on interrupt. (#187799, #187828, #187726) Thanks @bajiaoshan, @obviyus, @LinzeShi, and @SunnyShu0925.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete 90a5029e427822745c59e4f1268db08ade257d5b..a1f3f16e7b2e6a80c89e3ec852a2061120c62069 history: 351 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 351 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

body:
## 1.41.0 (2026-11-16)

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
### Features
* feat(verify-openhands): scenarios beyond the happy path, `map controls`, `browser timezone` by @enyst in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19670
* feat(acp): choose the reasoning effort from what the agent reports by @simonrosenberg in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19436
* feat(hooks): name the workspace and user hooks files in the Available Hooks dialog by @enyst in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/18366
* feat(analytics): instrument automation setup funnel dead ends by @neubig in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19394
* feat: reuse profile secret consent for automatic managed App enablement by @neubig in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/18572
* feat(automations): group the dashboard list by tag by @hieptl in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19745
* feat(automations): open assisted templates in the setup view and add the CVE Remediation Factory icon by @dylan-openhands in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19700
### Bug Fixes
* fix(theme): make catalog removal and restriction feedback readable by @enyst in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19485
* fix(conversations): delete all pages with one captured backend scope by @enyst in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/18367
* fix(theme): keep confirmation modal descriptions readable by @enyst in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/18540
* fix: generate UUIDs without crypto.randomUUID on plain-HTTP non-loopback origins by @neubig in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19732
* fix(mcp): send the browser's backend URL as the MCP OAuth callback base by @neubig in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19744
* fix(agent-profiles): sync agent_settings.agent_kind with the active profile on cloud by @suzhiguo7 in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/18913
* fix(automations): retain mobile setup drafts across view switches by @stefanielizeth73-art in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19386
* fix(modals): let an open combobox listbox take Escape before the dialog closes by @SaltGardenia in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19688
* fix: keep mobile conversation navigation visible by @niebloomj in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19711
* fix: allow secure replacement of requested secrets by @neubig in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19062
* fix(acp): refresh login status on focus and remount by @DevinVinson in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19729
* fix(canvas): advance Debian snapshot to 20261114 for linux-libc-dev security fixes by @openhands-agent in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19786
### Documentation
* docs(verify-openhands): map maintenance 2026-11-11 by @enyst in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19653
* docs(verify-openhands): map maintenance 2026-11-13 by @enyst in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19715
* docs(verify-openhands): map maintenance 2026-11-14 by @enyst in https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/19750

name: v5.1.75
body:
### Fixed

- `omo remote devices` shows this device offline while its device service is not connected, and `omo remote sessions --device` naming a device the account does not have reports it instead of listing nothing. ([#13916](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13916))
- Memory sync's own test suite no longer fails a later, unrelated test when one test times out while a sync cycle is still running: device teardown in the tests now stops the engine and waits for that cycle before removing its files, and the push-bounded test waits on the cycle instead of a fixed 30 s budget. ([#13887](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13887), fixes [#13680](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13680))
- The first memory sync cycle after signing in no longer fails with "the device's sign-in token could not be read or refreshed" when the system keychain briefly reads nothing. That one empty read is now checked again before sync treats the sign-in as gone; signing out still stops sync at once. ([#13879](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13879), fixes [#13739](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13739))
- Regenerating the computer-use prelude (`bun run generate` in `senpi-desktop-prelude`) now runs its generated method tables through `bun fmt`, so `prelude.js`, its `index.ts` allowlist and the desktop protocol tier tables stay formatter-clean instead of reverting to unformatted output at every release regeneration. The published prelude JavaScript is the formatted copy again. ([#13855](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13855))

### Changed

- A memory sync capture that receives files from other devices no longer scans every known file once per received file, so a large memory catching up on many incoming files stays fast. ([#13862](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13862))
