name: v5.1.74
body:
**A secret input or grant approval that settled while the relay link was down is now dismissed on the terminal that raised it after `omo remote attach` reconnects**, instead of staying open with an answer the session would refuse. ([#13773](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13773))

**The computer-use conformance preflight test cleans up its compiled stand-in engine reliably on Windows.** The test's temporary directory is now removed with the shared retrying helper, because Windows briefly keeps a just-run executable locked and Bun ignores `rmSync`'s retry options. QA tooling only; no runtime behaviour changes. ([#13299](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13299), part of #13221)

### Fixed

- The EQ.omo driver resolves a symlinked temp dir before it makes its sandboxes, so a recording on macOS no longer carries `/private<sandbox>` paths or an untrusted project. A new test fails when a platform's EQ.omo goldens were recorded with a senpi version more than a week away from the pinned one. ([#13865](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13865))
- CI: the desktop-bench comparison summary prints its regression thresholds (x1.3 and +0.5 ms) instead of `undefined`. It now reads them from `compareBench`'s result rather than destructuring names `eval-core.mjs` does not export. ([#13838](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13838), follow-up to #12876 review L1, [#12567](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12567))
- `omo remote bootstrap` installs device service 0.1.39 instead of 0.1.27, which was older than the wake and delivery minimum and answered open/create to the device with `unsupported`. ([#13803](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13803))
- A wake toward a device service older than the wake minimum now names the service's version, the minimum and the fix, instead of a bare `unsupported`. ([#13803](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13803))
- `omo remote devices` lists the device it runs on first (the account roster held only the other devices), and `--json` marks each row `this_device`. `omo remote sessions --device` with a device that is not on the account now fails with exit 2 naming it, instead of printing an empty list. ([#13458](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13458), part of [#13402](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13402))
- `thread_interrupt` also stops the background jobs the interrupted turn started (a bash command it ran in the background or that auto-detached), so the thread no longer wakes a minute later when that job ends and replies as if it had never been interrupted. The result names what was stopped as `background: { status: "stopped", stopped, failed }`; an engine that predates the stop answers `background: { status: "not_supported" }`. A thread on this device and a thread on another device run the same interrupt code and answer the same shape. ([#13444](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13444))
- Computer use v3 (fake backend): the source guard that bans environment reads now also reports a grouped `use std::{...}` import of the environment module when a `//` or `/* */` comment comes before the item inside the group. A comment can no longer hide an item, or split one at a comma or brace inside it. ([#13363](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13363))
- Desktop engine: the client retries a connection reset before the first reply byte only on Unix sockets, never on a Windows named pipe, where the daemon may already have run the request. ([#12744](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12744))

### Changed

- The `thread_read` wait limit (600,000 ms) is now internal to the thread schema instead of an unused export; the limit itself is unchanged. No behavior change. ([#13864](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13864))
- Internal: the Windows backend documents when its posted key route still sends a key under a held Alt: for modifier-only chords, when releasing held keys, and while a failed Alt release is still recorded as held. A Windows test is also renamed to match the order of its checks. Nothing changes for users. ([#13824](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13824), fixes [#13821](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13821))
- Internal: the module doc of the X11 input's client-process reader now names the `/proc/<pid>/exe` read added for the background-input check. Nothing changes for users. ([#13820](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13820), fixes [#13818](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13818))
- `/remote enable`, `/remote disable` and `/remote control` in the TUI now answer in a sentence ("Remote sessions are on for this device.", "Remote control is off: ...") instead of the CLI's raw JSON. When `/remote enable` cannot finish, it shows the CLI's reason (for example "Could not download the OmO device service.") instead of an exit code, and a warning the CLI prints while succeeding (for example that the device is not linked) now shows after the result. ([#13796](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13796))
- The remote module's public types no longer depend on internal modules, so the importable remote SDK ships clean type declarations. No command or tool behaves differently. ([#13782](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13782))
- The remote module gains its client factories, one per kind of caller (a person, including `omo remote`; a session; a connector; the thread SDK's own principal; the device service's bootstrap entry), and its public entry. Its alias operations work when the caller hands in the account's alias registry, naming each session by the same durable id the thread tools use, and a device that does not answer is reported as offline rather than as having no such session. Nothing calls them yet, so no command or tool behaves differently. ([#13750](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13750))
- The remote module now declares every operation a surface needs (part 4a-2): opening, messaging, reading, following, waiting on, interrupting and closing a session on any device, its model and thinking level, attaching with pending approvals, aliases and the wake switch. The operations that have not landed yet answer "unsupported" as data, and nothing calls them yet, so no command or tool behaves differently. ([#13747](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13747))
- Remote access now has its own module (part 4a-1 of the one remote module design): typed results, one code list, a deadline table and a clock seam, with the service, devices and session list members. Nothing uses it yet, so no command or tool behaves differently. ([#13498](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13498))
- The device service client takes one injectable clock for its handshake, request, endpoint-command and attach waits, so each of those deadlines can be tested on fake time. Real timers stay the default and no wait changed. ([#13473](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13473))
- Computer use v3: on Windows, one user's two logon sessions take turns at the computer instead of acting at once: the interaction lock is now the operating system's file lock on `%LOCALAPPDATA%\OmO\ComputerControl\run\interaction.lock`, in a directory only that user and SYSTEM can open, on a local NTFS or ReFS volume. A session without a runtime directory cannot act on a real machine; it can still read. ([#13367](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13367))
- The Windows live tier's ledger job now fails when a fresh measurement's verdict differs from the committed `crates/omo-computer-backend-win32/probes/hosted-windows-live.tsv`, naming each leg that moved, so the committed ledger only changes on purpose. ([#13274](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13274), part of [#13221](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13221))

### Added

- Computer use v3: the session crate's side-effect funnel lands. Every mutating call runs the gate, writes a pre-input marker before the first OS call on every transport, performs the call, reads back and writes one audit event per side effect; a crashed call is never resent and reads `delivery_uncertain`. Audit, lock, permits, batches and artifact retention come with it, and a typed secret is audited by length only. Nothing user-visible changes yet; the existing desktop engine is untouched. ([#13367](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13367))
- Computer use v3: the safety crate `omo-computer-safety` lands. It holds the fixed gate order (each gate refuses before any OS call with nothing sent), the supervisor whose stop commit releases every hold within 1 s or exits, the stop latch and persisted stop marker under the per-uid state root, the `live`/`deaf`/`none` stop paths with the host-relay-only policy, the per-OS protected tables and dangerous chords, and the self set. The walking skeleton's `click` and `typeText` now pass through the gate. Nothing user-visible changes yet; the existing desktop engine is untouched. ([#13353](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13353))
- Computer use v3: the walking skeleton lands. `omo-computer-engine` runs on the fake backend with `--stdio` (NDJSON JSON-RPC), `--schema`, `--selftest` and `--version`; the session answers `session.open`, `capabilities` and close plus the thin `click` and `typeText` verbs; refusals go through the closed `COMPUTER_*` table. `script/qa/computer/replay.ts` replays conformance cases against the engine binary and prints the JSON pointer of the first mismatch. Nothing user-visible changes yet; the existing desktop engine is untouched. ([#13352](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13352))
- Spike SP-R probe and ledger for the computer-use relay pipe: auth lifetime, hub hibernation, message-size and liveness limits measured against a local relay, plus read-only checks on a same-network pair and the hosted relay. Probe-only, no engine change. ([#13166](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13166), part of [#13051](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13051))
- Computer use v3: spike SP-W adds a Wayland probe and its ledger under `crates/omo-computer-backend-wayland/probes/`. The probe measures, in one container per compositor (GNOME 46, KDE Plasma 6, sway), whether portal restore tokens survive restarts, which portals exist, libei regions, a second `ConnectToEIS`, the clipboard grant, key release when an input owner dies, the GNOME extension and accessibility behaviour, and KWin window-management access. Each fact is one cited ledger row. Nothing user-visible changes. ([#13163](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13163))
- Desktop engine: several clients run by the same user can attach to one shared `--serve` daemon session (SDK `attach` over the Unix socket), each with its own replies; the daemon checks every client's peer credentials and closes a connection from another user before any byte. ([#12744](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12744))

### Known issues

- `bun fmt` over the whole tree still flags the generated desktop prelude (`packages/senpi-desktop-prelude/src/prelude.js`): its generator does not yet emit formatter-clean output. Formatting only; the shipped prelude behaves the same. The fix is tracked in [#13855](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13855).

name: v5.1.73
body:
**Remote session views stop receiving each streamed delta twice.** `open_session` for a remote create, open, or fork now goes on the endpoint dialer (a fresh connection per call, closed once it settles), instead of sharing the long-lived connection the later `session.attach` rides on; opening on the shared connection had attached the host's delegated engine connection to the session as well, so the engine wrote every delta twice. A connection a caller lends is now named borrowed, so the CLI's one shared connection survives the open. ([#13761](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13761), adopting [#13075](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13075) by @surlymochan)

**The first session on a newly enabled device now starts memory sync.** Sync used to start before the memory repository existed, fail to write its space binding, log "memory sync failed to start" and never retry; it now waits for the repository and starts on its own once the first memory write creates it. ([#13493](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13493), fixes #13486) ([#13627](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13627))

**Memory sync drops a replaced desktop account cleanly.** When the desktop moved to another account without announcing a retirement, the engine opened the new account but left the old one half alive: it kept listening on the desktop channel and its open sync sessions did not end. The old account now ends as soon as the engine sees it is no longer current, which also ends its sessions. In a session Worker, an operation started just before the desktop retired its account can no longer hand back a handle from the old account. - Memory: a contender recovering a lock from a dead owner no longer fails when that lock file is already gone by the time it removes it (seen on Windows, where memory reflection supervisors then failed admission). - Device operations run through the bundled fleet SDK (`bunshin` in eval cells) now fail with a typed error, `{ code, message, next_action }` like the thread tools, instead of an internal transport sentence. The message names the operation and the device, and the code tells a wrong argument (`invalid_arguments`) apart from an offline device (`device_offline`), a policy refusal (`scope_denied`) and a lost connection (`transport_closed`). The relay's own op-result codes pass through unchanged and carry `uncertain` when the device may have run the op. The "no transport" error and a failed connect now say what to do next. - Computer use on X11 no longer reports a background click, scroll, drag, typing or key chord as delivered when the target app drops synthetic input (GTK 3/4, Qt, LibreOffice, Chromium, Electron and Firefox apps whose window class names no toolkit, and xterm, whose `allowSendEvents` setting no other app can read). Send it with `delivery: "foreground"` or use accessibility actions. name: CC Switch v4.0.34
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.34

本版本的技能仓库支持 **GitLab、Gitea 和 Forgejo**（包括自建实例和 Codeberg），不再只能添加 GitHub 上的仓库。会话管理里现在可以直接删除 **Antigravity CLI** 的会话；开启自动下载更新后，发现新版本会立刻开始下载。另外，WorkBuddy 手动添加的模型可以设置思考强度，S3 同步也可以像 WebDAV 一样清除本机保存的配置。

另外修复了 Gemini CLI 的供应商「获取模型列表」报 Key 无效或拿到空列表；Codex 里的 GitHub Copilot 模型被当成不支持图片；阿里云 OSS、腾讯云 COS、华为云 OBS 用不了 S3 同步；Skills 目录里有失效链接时整个云同步上传失败；路由模式下 Fable 5.2 被显示成 Fable 5；Copilot 上的 Gemini 模型缓存命中率低；Copilot 上勾了 1M 的 Fable 模型请求失败等问题。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.34-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.34-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### 技能仓库支持 GitLab、Gitea 和 Forgejo

「管理技能仓库」以前只接受 github.com 的地址，现在也能添加 GitLab、Gitea、Forgejo 上的公开仓库（需求见 [#1324](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/1324)、[#4227](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/4227)），包括自建实例和 Codeberg：

- 填 `owner/name` 仍按 GitHub 处理；填其他站点的完整地址时，CC Switch 会先问一次这个站点是 Gitea / Forgejo 还是 GitLab，再按对应的方式下载。自定义端口、GitLab 的多级分组、Gitea 页面上复制的地址都能用。
- 浏览技能、安装、检查更新和「打开文档」链接都会去仓库所在的站点。
- 只支持公开仓库，地址必须是 https。Gitee 暂不支持（它的下载接口需要令牌）。
- 同一个 `owner/name` 只能保留在一个站点上，在另一个站点添加同名仓库会替换原来的。

### 在会话管理里删除 Antigravity CLI 会话

以前 Antigravity 的会话只能在 agy 里删。现在可以在会话管理里直接删除 Antigravity CLI 的会话，删除时会和 agy 自己一样，把它的会话索引和摘要一并清理，重启 agy 后不会再冒出来。

- 会话正在 agy 里打开时不能删，先在 agy 里关掉它。
- Antigravity IDE 的会话，以及只有索引、没有会话记录的会话，仍然要在 Antigravity 里删除。

### 发现新版本后立刻开始自动下载

开启「自动下载更新」后，以前要等启动约 1 分钟后的后台检查才开始下载，「关于」页只显示有新版本，看起来像开关没生效。现在启动时一发现新版本就开始下载，「关于」页的新版本提示下会显示「正在后台下载新版本…」或「已下载完毕」。安装确认框的图标、文字和按钮也重新对齐了。

### WorkBuddy 手动添加的模型可以设置思考强度

预设里的 WorkBuddy 模型早就能在 WorkBuddy 的模型菜单里选思考强度，手动添加或从模型列表选的模型却只有思考开关（见 [#9599](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9599)）。现在打开思考后，模型详情里可以勾选要提供的「思考强度」，并设置「可以关闭思考」；都不勾时仍只显示思考开关。从模型列表获取的模型也会按 Pi 表单的规则自动填上可用的强度。

### S3 同步可以清除本机配置

S3 同步设置新增「清除配置」，和 WebDAV 一样：从本机删除保存的区域、存储桶、密钥、端点和远程目录，并停止自动同步，存储桶里已经上传的数据不会删除。

---

## 修复

- **Gemini CLI 的供应商「获取模型列表」报 Key 无效，或者用兼容网关时拿到空列表**（见 [#8546](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8546)）：以前按 `Authorization: Bearer` 发 AI Studio Key，Google 不认；现在按 Gemini 原生方式获取。上一版修好的是 Claude Code / Claude Desktop 选 Gemini Native 格式的供应商，这次修的是 Gemini CLI 自己的供应商。
- **Codex 里用 GitHub Copilot 时，支持图片的模型被当成只支持文字**（[#8027](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8027)，见 [#7977](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7977)）：获取模型列表时会读取 Copilot 声明的图片输入能力。已经添加的 Copilot 供应商，请重新获取模型列表并保存，再完全退出并重启 Codex。
- **阿里云 OSS、腾讯云 COS、华为云 OBS 用不了 S3 同步，被提示 Access Key 错误**（见 [#3996](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/3996)）：这三家的新存储桶拒绝旧的路径式地址，现在会自动改用把存储桶放在域名里的地址。MinIO、R2 等其他服务不变。
- **S3 同步设置里选的服务商，重新打开设置页后没记住**（[#8644](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8644)）。
- **Skills 目录里有失效的链接时，云同步整个上传失败**（见 [#9615](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9615)）：失效的符号链接，或 Windows 上打不开的目录联接，以前会让上传整体中止（Windows 上报 `os error 5`），下载时也会在备份现有 Skills 这一步失败。现在跳过这类链接并记录警告。
- **路由模式下上游是 Fable 5.2 时，Claude Code 的 `/model` 仍显示 Fable 5**（见 [#9608](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9608)）：Fable 5.2 / 5.1 现在写成对应版本的模型 ID，Claude Desktop 同样修正。
- **经 GitHub Copilot 用 Gemini 模型时，长会话的缓存命中率只有约 27%**（见 [#9613](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9613)）：Claude Code 每一轮都会追加一条系统消息，Copilot 看起来会把它们都挪到请求开头，导致每轮请求的开头都变了。现在只对 Copilot 上的 Gemini 模型，把会话中途的系统消息按原位置作为用户消息发送，开头不再变化。其他供应商和模型不受影响。
- **经 GitHub Copilot 用 Fable 模型并勾选 1M 时，请求报 400**：Copilot 没有 1M 版本的 Claude 模型，现在会退回同版本的普通模型。获取过 Copilot 模型列表后，没有 1M 版本（上下文也不到 1M）的模型不能再勾 1M；已经勾了的会列在提示里，建议取消，因为 Claude Code 仍会按 1M 规划上下文。
- **在设置里改了 Hermes 的配置目录后，供应商没有写进新目录**（[#9567](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9567)）。
- **MCP 连通性检测或 DeepSeek Harness 登录出过一次内部错误后，要重启 CC Switch 才能再用**（[#9572](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9572)）。
- **供应商名称、地址或模型名里带 mistral 字样，就会被当成 Mistral 处理思考强度**（[#9573](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9573)）：现在只认官方地址 `api.mistral.ai`。
- 新增 Qwen4 Max 的价格（[#9612](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9612)）。

---

## 升级说明

**数据库版本从 26 升到 27**，为技能仓库记录它所在的站点。升级前会自动备份数据库；升级后再退回旧版本，旧版本会提示数据库版本过新，打不开。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @SaladDay（S3 清除配置、Hermes 配置目录同步、Mistral 识别、锁恢复，以及本版约 45 个 PR 的代码整理：拆分大文件、合并重复逻辑、删除没用的代码和界面文案、补齐前后端一致性测试）、@paulo-t（GitLab 技能仓库）、@EdwinDigital（Copilot 模型图片能力）、@Dopetaiga（记住 S3 服务商）、@kilingzhang、@xiaoyx1107（国内云 S3 地址）、@yreidev（Qwen4 Max 价格）的贡献。

感谢 @xzxiaoshan、@mercutiojohn、@axlrose、@LeenixP、@loseheart-dev、@kebe7jun、@hurleychin 报告问题和提供复现信息。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

name: v1.19.6
body:
## Desktop

### Improvements
- OpenCode 1 now offers the upgrade to OpenCode 2.0. OpenCode 2 downloads in the background and installs only when you choose: Restart to upgrade, Upgrade on quit, or Later. Your sessions, projects, and settings are kept. Plugins made for OpenCode 1 need an update.

## Core

### Bugfixes
- Sessions with many images no longer send oversized requests. When the images in a session's history pass 25 MiB, the oldest are replaced with a placeholder.
- A provider error for a request body that is too large now starts compaction and a retry instead of failing the turn.

name: fresh-editor 0.5.9
body:
## 0.5.9

For live updates on Fresh, [follow me on X](https://x.com/TheNoamLewis).

> Most config options below can be changed in the **Settings UI** - run **Open Settings** from the command palette (`Ctrl+P`).

### Features

* **Theme chrome and file icons** - themes can go borderless, style the gutter and explorer, and pick tab and status bar separator glyphs (including Powerline-style sections and caps). With Nerd Font icons on, the explorer and tabs show file-type icons, which themes can override. Two new built-in themes, `flat` and `quiet`, show it off (#3735)
* **Theme editor previews live** - edits show in the real editor as you make them, and every theme option, glyph and icon can be edited (#3735)
* **Markdown previews of diagrams and math** - in compose mode, Mermaid and LaTeX/math blocks are drawn by external tools (e.g. `termaid`, `utftex`) when installed; any code block language can be mapped to a command (#3751 by @PilotLeoYan)
* **Recent Files** - File > **Recent Files...** (or the command palette) reopens a file you closed in this window; the list survives a restart (#3755)
* **Explorer dims gitignored entries** when they are shown (#3283, #3290 by @CnsMaple)
* **Workboard** - a new Orchestrator board with every workspace and agent, grouped by what needs you, by project, by folder or as a kanban; a status bar beacon jumps to the next waiting agent (#3736)
* **New Welcome screen** - one short page with the latest release's changes, the essential keys and a Nerd Font switch (#3738)
* **LSP completions use the server's replace range** (`textEdit`) (#3734 by @andsuli)
* **Clickable search arrows in the status bar** step to the next/previous match (#3665 by @haigithub)
* **Ctrl+P file mode: Tab completes the longest common prefix** of the matching paths (#3293, requested by @asukaminato0721; #3581 by @peyton-durand)
* **Plugins can declare map settings**, edited in the Settings UI as a list of entries (#3751)

### Bug Fixes

* **Windows keeps key modifiers** - Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+I and Ctrl+Shift+letter are no longer read as plain keys in Windows Terminal and WezTerm (#3521, reported by @BrettKinny; #3602 by @neatsorg)
* **Ctrl/Alt+Shift+Tab are recognized**, and passed through to terminal panes (#3601 by @neatsorg)
* **`fresh FILE` remembers the cursor position** after quitting with the file open (#3748, reported by @shemgp)
* **LSP diagnostics refresh** - servers like rust-analyzer and Roslyn now push updated diagnostics without an edit (#3681, #3682 by @StonesFromTheSky)
* **Live diff and git gutter ignore line-ending style** - CRLF vs LF no longer marks whole files as changed on Windows (#3747 by @ezleyton)
* **Remote paths across platforms** - a Windows client on a Linux host (or the reverse) no longer mangles path separators; Unix file names containing `\` open correctly (#3758, #3762, #3581)
* **macOS honors `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` and `XDG_DATA_HOME`**; existing installs keep their current directories until the new ones exist (#3496, #3497 by @LuisAlejandro)
* **Terminals restore in the directory the shell `cd`'d to**, and an exited terminal keeps its tab name across a restart (#3740, #3074)
* **Inlay hints keep their own colour** next to a highlighted bracket or search match (#3622 by @mommysgoodpuppy)
* **Word navigation in prompts handles non-ASCII letters** - Ctrl+Left/Right/Backspace no longer split words like "café" (#3721 by @56steve)
* **Glob `?` matches one whole character**, including accented and emoji file names (#3620 by @56steve)
* **Smart Home on a wrapped line** no longer lands inside a multi-byte indent character (#3619 by @neatsorg)
* **Orchestrator: a project whose folder was moved says so** and offers to repoint it, instead of opening in the home folder (#3746)
* **Holding Down on the Welcome page** no longer scrolls into blank space (#3739)
* **Settings: Status Bar Left/Right editor is easier to read** (#3756)
* **Flatpak uses a supported runtime**, silencing the end-of-life warning (#3752 by @Daniel-at-github)

### Internals

* Debian packaging updates following mentors review, and flaky test fixes (#3728, #3729, #3730, #3737, #3744, #3745, #3750, #3678 by @neatsorg)

name: TensorFlow 2.22.0-rc1
body:
# Release 2.22.0

## TensorFlow

### Breaking Changes

The TensorBoard dependency is no longer included by default. If you use `tf.summary.*` APIs or `tf.keras.callbacks.TensorBoard`, please install the `tensorboard` package separately (`pip install tensorboard`). Otherwise, TensorFlow will raise an ImportError.

In `tensorflow/c/experimental/filesystem/filesystem_interface.h`, removed `TF_TransactionToken` and associated APIs.

### Major Features and Improvements

* Support for Python 3.14 (`cp314` and `cp314t` free-threaded concurrency) has been added across Linux, macOS, and Windows.
* Upgraded Intel oneDNN to v3.14.1 with optimized convolution and transpose kernels.
* Initial support for NVIDIA CUDA 13 has been added (`pip install tensorflow-cuda13`).
* `tf.lite`:
    * Adds support for QUI4 (Quantized Unsigned 4-bit) in Dequantize operator.
    * Adds support for FP16 and BF16 in Unpack operator.
    * Adds support for FP16 in Transpose and DynamicUpdateSlice operator.
    * Transpose now supports up to 8D tensors.
    * Adds support for FLOAT8_E4M3FN and FLOAT8_E5M2 data types.

### Bug Fixes and Other Changes

* `CheckpointReader`: Releases GIL during read operations to prevent deadlocks under multithreading.
* `CUDA Driver`: Demotes missing CUDA driver log from warning to VLOG(1) when run on CPU-only machines.
* `BatchFunction Operator`: Adds `num_warmup_batch_threads` and `per_criticality_batch_timeout_micros` attributes.
* `TensorFlow API`: Exports `__new__` in public API golden files for subclasses of `tuple` (`tf.io.FixedLenFeature`).
* `tf.data`: Fixes a bug in `tf.data.Dataset.scan` where state shape returned by `scan_func` was not strictly validated.
* `tf.image.adjust_contrast`: Registers missing Python gradient for `AdjustContrastv2` op. Fixes [#126083](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/issues/126083).
* `tf.nn.softsign`: Fixes second-order gradients of `tf.nn.softsign`.
* `tf.math.reciprocal`: Constrains XLA registration of `Reciprocal` and `Inv` to device-supported types. Fixes [#126414](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/issues/126414).
* `tf.experimental.numpy`: `isclose` and `allclose` now apply `rtol`/`atol` to integer inputs.
* `tf.image.non_max_suppression`: Fixes segmentation fault under `jit_compile=True` when boxes/scores are empty. Fixes [#117245](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/issues/117245).

name: v0.14.0
body:
The latest release of Lore, Epic Games' next-generation open source version control system.

[Quickstart](https://epicgames.github.io/lore/tutorials/quickstart/) | [Design](https://epicgames.github.io/lore/explanation/system-design/) | [Documentation](https://epicgames.github.io/lore/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/E4SFJKRPbg)

## Quick Install

Windows
```
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EpicGames/lore/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex
```

macOS / Linux
```
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EpicGames/lore/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
```

## Release Notes

Changes since v0.13.0.

### Breaking changes

* Branch metadata keys `archived`, `restored`, `restoring` and `released` are reserved for archives and restores; remove or rename values stored under them before upgrading
* An invalid `LORE_AUTH_STORE`, or a user-level `config.toml` that can't be read or parsed, stops every command. Commands relayed to the service without `LORE_AUTH_STORE` use the secure store
* The Lore service and its clients must come from the same build; end a running service after upgrading
* Requests the server or authentication service refuses fail with `NotAuthenticated` (16) or `NotAuthorized` (17) instead of an internal error (255), `NotConnected` (29) or a not-found code
* `lore branch create` with an invalid name and a refused `lore repository instance move` exit with `InvalidArguments` (3); `lore clone --root-file` with a missing file exits with 82
* C API: push events start with their `repository` and `branch`, and the instance-delete begin event drops `dry_run`. Rebuild against the new `lore.h`
* Switching, resetting or pushing to an archived branch leaves it archived; `lore push` restores it, other clients restore it with a branch create
* Mutable store plugins must remove a key swapped to zero and refuse a swap from a non-zero value on an absent key
* `lore-server`: a `remote` immutable store trusts its upstream and checks only payload sizes (`verify = true` restores full checks)
* `lore-server`: QUIC storage request failures log under the `lore_server::quic` target

### Features

* Virtual clones on Linux with `lore clone --vfs fuse`, served from the shared store and supporting status, stage, commit, sync, reset and merge. `--vfs default` now picks FUSE on Linux
* `lore clone --vfs fuse --prefetch <file>` warms the store from an access recording (`LORE_FUSE_RECORD_DIR`)
* `lore repository instance clone` copies an instance on a shared store, sharing data blocks on APFS, Btrfs, XFS, ReFS and Dev Drive
* `[auth]` in the user-level `config.toml` chooses the token store (`store`, `path`)
* Per-instance ignore rules in `.lore/ignore`
* `--fast-flush` writes the local store's index in place, which is faster on Windows
* `[store] cache_payloads` sets whether fetched and written content is kept in the store
* The Lore service closes remote connections idle for 5 minutes (`idle_connection_timeout`)
* `lore-unix://` remotes reach a machine server through a Unix socket (`LORE_UDS_SOCKET`), which `lore-server` serves to containers with `[server.uds]`
* `lore-server`: `client_credentials_scopes` for OIDC providers, requested by `lore auth login --client-id`
* `lore-server`: round-robin read replica selection for composite stores (`read_replica_selection`)
* `lore-server`: HTTP range requests on the content and presigned endpoints
* `lore-server`: `ThinClientService.RevisionTree` can attribute entries to the revision that last changed them
* `lore-server`: `server.upstream_connections` sets the connections to a `remote` store's upstream (default 4)

### Fixes & Improvements

* `lore push` pushes branches, layers and links up to 8 at a time, and each linked branch only once
* Faster lookup of the revision shared with the remote, without endless loops or wrong merge bases
* Fixed concurrent branch creates, restores, archives and metadata edits undoing each other
* Merges, cherry-picks, reverts and syncs handle case-only renames on both sides
* Fixed `lore file dirty`, `lore file dirty move` and `lore stage move` losing moves or dropping files from a commit
* Fixed forced stages, unstages and merges under a sparse view corrupting or losing changes
* Replacing a file with a folder, or the reverse, reports a merge conflict instead of failing with `Not a directory`
* Fixed several merge, resolve, reset and obliterate problems inside links
* Instances on a shared store keep their file times in `.lore/records/`, so they no longer rewrite each other's
* Commands that change the user-level `config.toml` keep settings they don't know
* Fixed content missing from the local store after concurrent reads or eviction, and commits failing with "leader upload failed"
* C API revision-tree handles are safe under concurrent deletes and moves
* SWFS: release builds need no dynamic C runtime, and files a sync brings back are no longer missing
* `lore-server`: fixed `lore push --fast-forward-merge` storing revisions with mismatched directory hashes
* `lore-server`: DynamoDB compare-and-swap fixes for zero values and refused swaps
* `lore-server`: the replicated immutable store spreads requests over several connections (`num_clients`)
* `lore-server`: fixed `RevisionDiff` and `RevisionTree` results around links and merges
* `lore-server`: accepts partition-scoped tokens from a separate `token_exchange_issuer`

## Release Assets

> [!IMPORTANT]
These can be downloaded under the "Assets" section below.

### Installer
- `lore-setup` - Lore CLI Windows installer

### Binaries
- `lore` - Lore CLI
- `loreserver` - Lore Server
- `liblore` - Lore Shared Library

### Headers
- `lore.h` - Single header for `liblore` (packaged with `liblore`)

### Supported Platforms
- Windows x86_64
- macOS AArch64
- Linux x86_64
- Linux AArch64
- Linux AArch64, optimized for Graviton/Neoverse 512-tvb

## Lore Desktop Client

> [!IMPORTANT]
Lore Desktop Client is available as binaries only, download the installer for your platform here:

- Windows: [Lore-Desktop-Setup-x64.exe](https://releases.lore.org/desktop/releases/stable/Lore-Desktop-Setup-x64.exe)
- macOS: [Lore-Desktop-arm64.dmg](https://releases.lore.org/desktop/releases/stable/Lore-Desktop-arm64.dmg)
- Linux (Ubuntu 24.04): [lore-desktop_amd64.deb](https://releases.lore.org/desktop/releases/stable/lore-desktop_amd64.deb)
- Linux (AppImage): [Lore-Desktop-x86_64.AppImage](https://releases.lore.org/desktop/releases/stable/Lore-Desktop-x86_64.AppImage)

name: 1.26.1 — Word spaces kept under kerning
body:
Changes since 1.26.0:

- Keep a word space painted as its own run when the next word is kerned back over it, and after closing punctuation as well as after a word: `Regulations (CFR) and` painted as `(CFR`, `)`, a space and `and` no longer reads `(CFR)and`. The test is the gap the junction leaves rather than the width of the space run, so wide gaps are still left to gap detection (#666).

API: unchanged.

Release preparation: #667.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/firecrawl/pdf-inspector/compare/v1.26.0...v1.26.1)

## Release Notes

Released on 2026-11-17.

### Preview features

- Support PEP 832 `.venv` redirect files for project environments ([#21822](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/21822))
- Add the `http2-keep-alive` preview feature to close unresponsive HTTP/2 connections with active requests ([#23236](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23236))

### Performance

- Reduce lockfile size and speed up reads by factoring repeated conditions in environment markers ([#23184](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23184))

### Bug fixes

- Reject wheels advertised by an index under a different package name ([#23261](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23261))
- Fix `uv lock --locked` rejecting lockfiles with equivalent platform markers written in different forms ([#23185](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23185))
- Correctly quote environment marker values that contain apostrophes ([#23185](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23185))
- Report which musl interpreter failed to return a readable version ([#23213](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23213))

### Other changes

- Raise the minimum supported Rust version to 1.98 ([#23263](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/23263))

name: Sub2API 0.2.22
body:
> AI API Gateway Platform - 将 AI 订阅配额分发和管理

分组新增强制 OpenAI Ultra Fast 档位，Vertex 账号支持 us/eu 多区域端点；同时大幅优化单用户高并发扣费、调度快照与请求体解析性能。

## 新增功能

- 分组强制 Ultra Fast：OpenAI / Composite 分组可强制 service_tier=ultrafast，仅对支持的模型（GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol）生效，可与强制 Fast 并存（优先级 Ultra Fast > Fast > 客户端）
- Vertex 多区域：Gemini 账号支持 us/eu 多区域端点，不支持的模型自动走 global；发往多区域的请求在默认定价下按 1.1 倍计费（分组/渠道自定义价格不受影响）
- 新增 Gemini 4 Carbon 模型支持，补齐 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 计费
- OpenAI 透传账号可选按模型白名单过滤调度
- 并发等待 ping 支持配置 concurrency.ping_interval=0 关闭，避免提前写入 HTTP 状态码

## 优化改进

- 同一用户的扣费按用户通道合并结算，消除余额热点行排队，单用户高并发下延迟与内存显著下降
- 调度快照加载与数据库回源按 bucket 合并，减少大分组选号时的重复加载与整组复制
- 请求体热点路径改用零拷贝读取，Anthropic 请求路径与流事件转发减少 JSON 解码与复制
- 分组日汇总重建与保留期清理不再阻塞 usage_logs 写入，避免清理期间用量记录丢失
- 上游死连接检测由约 165 秒缩短到约 30 秒
- 启动时远程价格哈希检查改为后台进行，不再阻塞服务启动
- Gemini 原生请求按稳定前缀生成粘性会话哈希，提升隐式缓存命中
- Bedrock 按错误语义区分封号、用例缺失、限流与内容过滤，429 只冷却对应模型
- Kimi 支持新版月度套餐额度解析
- Codex 分叉会话沿用父会话的 prompt cache key，保留缓存命中
- 模型白名单禁止添加通配符条目并给出提示

## Bug 修复

- 修复 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 Ultra Fast 计费倍率（由 2 倍修正为 6 倍，与 Astra 一致）
- 修复 Gemini 粘性会话换号时强制按缓存读取计费的问题，改为按上游实际用量计费
- 修复 Gemini 流式同名并行工具调用、分片工具调用参数快照丢失的问题
- 修复 Gemini 兼容入口未转发 response_format 结构化输出的问题
- 修复 Antigravity 兼容流思考内容未流式输出、空流后未释放粘性账号的问题
- 修复 OpenAI 首个输出前的上游 keepalive 未转发、keepalive 后 SSE 错误无法下发的问题
- 修复 OpenAI 兼容路径输出后的流错误未应用账号副作用、Messages 桥接首包前错误未 failover 的问题
- 修复 OpenAI 工具 Schema 中 patternProperties、Python re 不支持的正则、嵌套 schema 编辑的兼容问题
- 修复 Codex additional_tools 声明 ID 被改写、HTTP Responses 额外上下文未规范化的问题
- 修复 Chat Completions 转 Responses 时 json_schema 默认 strict、对话中途 system 消息、加密函数调用内容丢失的问题
- 修复 Chat Completions 转 Anthropic 时客户端 metadata.user_id 丢失的问题（API Key 账号）
- 修复 Anthropic 兼容路由未执行 effort 策略、per-turn beta 丢失输出配置的问题
- 修复 Composite 路由响应中公开模型名未还原、模型改写范围过大的问题
- 修复 count_tokens 透传重复请求头的问题
- 修复客户端断开后粘性绑定未写入的问题
- 修复 Claude 并发 token 轮换后请求失败的问题
- 修复 Claude 账号测试默认模型，改为 claude-sonnet-4-6
- 修复 Fable 周额度读取与 7d_oi 窗口恢复后模型限流未解除的问题，5h 窗口滚动不再清空周用量读数
- 修复 5h 窗口起点与额度重置时间不对齐的问题
- 修复调度快照遗漏冷却中账号、openai_capabilities 与透传模型过滤配置的问题
- 修复 RPM 覆盖值误用于其他分组、分组倍率/RPM 同步失败时清空覆盖配置的问题
- 修复支付宝退款重试可能重复退款的问题
- 修复按账户筛选时模型/端点分布的实际扣费被替换为账号成本的问题
- 修复 Chat 回退与原生 Anthropic 路径响应模型记录丢失的问题
- 修复 DeepSeek 显式 token 价格覆盖不生效的问题，补充硅基流动 Qwen3-Embedding / Reranker 兜底定价
- 修复联网搜索在部分平台忽略账号级模式的问题
- 修复 OpenAI 额度刷新失败导致渠道监控在异常与正常间反复切换的问题
- 修复 Grok 媒体错误信息丢失、服务端搜索调用混入工具调用的问题
- 修复国内厂商额度单元格与 Gemini 用量刷新时不更新或消失的问题
- 修复渠道 Bedrock 兼容开关保存类型错误的问题
- 修复设置注入的 HTML 被缓存导致品牌信息过期与 CSP nonce 不匹配的问题
- 修复登录回填邮箱身份失败时 panic 的问题
- 修复无法设置 TCP_USER_TIMEOUT 的平台上上游拨号失败的问题



---

## 📥 Installation

**Docker:**
```bash
# Docker Hub
docker pull weishaw/sub2api:0.2.22

# GitHub Container Registry
docker pull ghcr.io/wei-shaw/sub2api:0.2.22
```

**One-line install (Linux):**
```bash
curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api/main/deploy/install.sh | sudo bash
```

**Manual download:**
Download the appropriate archive for your platform from the assets below.

body:
## en-US

### Patch Changes

- ae0ce7a: Add the named compile workflow and its CLI guide. FileBrowser now reports selected tree entries so hosts can add directory references to VikingBot, whose send button uses a rounded square.

- 62d5cd5: Support switching named compilation configurations through directory-style tabs, native Git snapshot history, and Wiki edits with explicit snapshots.

  Propagate pending Wiki conflicts from deeply nested files to every ancestor directory, including collapsed subtrees, and refresh cleared markers. Preserve conflict tags loaded after an older empty index, and let refreshed conflict results override historical compilation counts. Skip inaccessible directory placeholders while traversing containers with readable descendants. Respect write-permission changes in open configuration editors, compare the first version against an empty baseline, and refresh the current version after a restore conflict before allowing another confirmation.

  Align compilation settings with directory and Skill pickers, full-path tooltips, frequency radio cards and time selection. Add file selection, historical comparison and file restore to Wiki history in a full-width document panel with the FileViewer diff renderer, hide history for ordinary resource files and while editing, improve pack upload, and keep model names and dashboard tooltips readable.

  Keep history loading indicators centred, show initial picker loading immediately, reuse an Arco-derived Switch, keep target paths on one line and hide view switching while editing. Fix the selected background of the history Preview / Markdown tabs.

  Complete theme fallbacks on migrated workflow roots, align dark surfaces, schedule selection borders, history badges and diff legends, and apply the console theme to Switch sizes and unavailable states. Preserve the FileViewer's native diff colours. Show the empty state when a selected directory file has no historical versions, including after retrying a failed request.

- a08cec9: Fix Console showing a command-unavailable warning during execution. CommandConsole now accepts `busy` to lock input and submission while pending result cards show progress; `disabled` retains its unavailable message.

- 63da276: Align the typography and colors of CommandConsole and VikingBot with the console design. Simplify completed resource import cards and add a result action to CLI completion notifications.

- 63da276: Updating a mounted `FileBrowser`'s controlled `uri` opens the preview and reveals the resource in the directory tree. Hosts that need a preview-only update can call `openResource(uri, { reveal: false })`. Use `defaultExpandedUri` to set the initial tree expansion.

- a4c0257: Allow FileBrowser hosts to override individual experience dashboard requests while retaining the built-in UI, pagination, retries, and cancellation.

- 0a7197c: After saving an editable ordinary file in FileBrowser, choose whether to keep a snapshot, then enter a description and save it. Snapshot failures retain the description for retry and do not undo the file save. Wiki compile files retain their automatic version history.

- 41108b0: Hide the Preview / Source switch during editing. FileBrowser keeps version history available and copies the current editor draft.

- 62d5cd5: Use the same theme background for the file tree panel, FileBrowser directory pane and sticky trailing actions. Keep normal, hover and selected surfaces consistent in light and dark themes without host-specific overrides, while preserving text masking during horizontal scrolling.

- 41108b0: Replace the file path in Wiki conflict rows with a compact pencil button. File Browser opens the editor directly for pending conflicts when editing is allowed.

- 41108b0: Use tagged data-plane search to list Wiki conflicts and mark directories with pending conflicts, even when the matching files are collapsed. Refresh conflict status after saving a Wiki file. Accept the current and legacy Compile registry response fields.

## zh-CN

### 修复与改进

- ae0ce7a: 新增按名称创建和执行编译的流程及 CLI 指引。FileBrowser 支持上报选中的目录树条目，宿主可将目录引用传给 VikingBot，发送按钮采用圆角方形。

- 62d5cd5: 支持通过目录风格的页签切换编译配置、原生 Git 快照历史，以及显式保留 Wiki 编辑快照。

  Wiki 深层文件的待处理冲突沿祖先目录逐级显示，目录折叠时保留，刷新后清除已解决的标记；旧空索引不覆盖后来加载到的冲突标签，刷新结果优先于历史编译统计；跳过无权限目录占位，保留可展开目录的可读后代遍历。已打开的配置编辑器响应写权限变化，首个版本默认与空内容比较，版本回滚冲突后刷新当前版本，供用户再次确认。

  编译配置使用目录和 Skill 选择器，补充完整路径提示、频次单选卡片与时间选择。Wiki 历史使用全宽文档面板和 FileViewer 差异视图，支持文件选择、历史版本对比和文件回滚；普通资源文件及编辑状态隐藏历史入口，优化 pack 上传界面、模型名称换行与看板提示位置。

  历史加载状态保留内容高度并显示居中图标，目录和 Skill 选择器打开即进入加载态；查看变更复用迁移自 Arco 的共享 Switch，目标路径保持单行，编辑时隐藏视图切换。修复历史正文「预览 / Markdown」页签的选中背景色。

  在迁入流程的根节点补齐主题兜底，对齐暗色背景、更新频次选中边框、历史标记与差异图例，并让 Switch 的尺寸和不可用状态采用控制台主题；差异正文保留 FileViewer 原生配色；目录内文件暂无历史版本时展示空态，加载失败后重试同样正确展示。

- a08cec9: 修复 Console 执行命令时误显示不可用提示的问题。CommandConsole 新增 `busy`，在等待结果时锁定输入与提交，由执行中的结果卡片展示进度；`disabled` 保留不可用提示。

- 63da276: 对齐 CommandConsole 和 VikingBot 与控制台的字体及配色，精简资源导入完成卡片，并在 CLI 完成通知中添加查看结果入口。

- 63da276: 更新已挂载的 `FileBrowser` 的受控 `uri` 时，区块会打开预览并在目录树中定位资源。需要仅更新预览的宿主可调用 `openResource(uri, { reveal: false })`。用 `defaultExpandedUri` 设置初始展开位置。

- a4c0257: FileBrowser 支持由宿主替换经验看板的单项请求，并沿用内置界面、分页、重试和请求取消。

- 0a7197c: FileBrowser 保存普通可编辑文件后，可选择是否保留快照，再填写描述并保存。快照失败会保留描述以供重试，不影响已保存的文件；Wiki 编译文件沿用自动版本历史。

- 41108b0: 编辑态隐藏「预览 / 源码」切换。文件浏览区块保留版本历史，复制正文时取当前编辑草稿。

- 62d5cd5: 统一文件树面板、FileBrowser 目录面板与行尾吸附操作区的主题背景，浅色、深色、悬停和选中态保持一致，无需宿主额外适配，并保留横向滚动时对文字的遮挡。

- 41108b0: Wiki 冲突列表将文件路径替换为铅笔图标按钮。有编辑权限时，可从文件浏览器的待确认冲突直接进入编辑。

- 41108b0: 通过数据面标签检索列出 Wiki 冲突，即使冲突文件所在分支处于收起状态，也能标记待确认冲突目录。保存 Wiki 文件后更新冲突状态，同时兼容当前和旧版的编译配置响应字段。

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### macOS (arm64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) [builds for older glibc](https://github.com/neovim/neovim-releases).

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage`

     ```bash
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (arm64)

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

# OpenWhispr 1.12.0

A new assistant window you can talk to from any app, Private notes and Teams for workspaces, and one-screen local setup.

## 🌟 Highlights

- **🎙️ A new assistant window** — Press the assistant hotkey in any app and speak or type. It answers in its own window, edits the text you selected, or types the answer into the field you're in. It asks you questions mid-task, drafts emails and Slack replies for you to edit and send, and keeps your chat when you minimize it.
- **🔒 Private notes** — Every workspace gets a Private section for your own notes, and it follows you across devices.
- **👥 Teams, Teamspaces and Guests** — A People page with bulk invites and removals, plus an overview of every teamspace.
- **🧭 One-screen local setup** — Recommended models for your computer, downloaded for you.
- **📡 Signed model registry** — New and retired models arrive between releases. Turn it off in Settings → Privacy.
- **💬 Background chats** — Leave a chat mid-answer and it keeps going, and several can answer at once.
- **🏢 Organization controls** — Managed device policy, update policy and local model allow lists.

## ✨ Also new

- The assistant replies in Slack threads, reads your calendar with the right weekdays, and no longer claims it sent something it didn't
- Import your Dragon vocabulary
- OpenRouter speech-to-text
- Choose your default summary template
- Better speaker ID for Chinese and English meetings

## 🛠 Fixes

- Accounts on one computer no longer share history, chats or dictionary.
- Team notes no longer stall after a sync conflict.
- Meetings drop stray wrong-script fragments and match speakers better.
- Windows: the mic opens faster and the pill stays draggable. Linux: works without AVX2. macOS: skipping Accessibility now explains why text was only copied.


Full details in the [changelog](https://github.com/OpenWhispr/openwhispr/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#1120---2026-11-17).

## 🙏 Thanks

Thanks to @Chadpiha, @greatcoat, @boseq, @IdrisGit, @kuleje, @widechaos, @henmedia, @hpflatorre, @Ker102, @injaamam, @maxazure, @mariushm, @clarkmaan and @etzelm. 🎉

name: v1.0.0
body:
**Swarms, Cloud, and a lighter terminal**

### Highlights

- Reworked swarms plan jobs in phases and parallel lanes, automatically start workers as dependencies finish, and show the whole team's progress in one pinned view
- jcode Cloud officially launches: move a session or coordinated swarm to a VM with /cloud, keep working after disconnecting, and bring the conversation and repository back with /local
- A lighter terminal with lower CPU usage, fewer background wakeups, faster transcript rendering, and less rendered-text memory

### Improvements

- In our own jcode development sessions, worker launches increased from 88 to 174 between November 2–8 and November 9–15, averaging roughly three times as many worker dispatches per active session
- A profiled release client used 25% less CPU, idle client wakeups fell from 2.68 to 1.51 per second, and rendered-span memory in a large conversation fell from 20.4 MB to 14.6 MB
- Spinner-frame processing became 3.5 times faster and append-frame processing on a 4,000-message transcript became 8.3 times faster
- Cloud sessions load recent history first and fetch older messages on demand; a 7,000-message session's initial history payload shrank from 14.3 MB to 261 KB
- Search full conversations in /resume with typo tolerance, live previews, and local and cloud sessions in the same picker
- Set account priority tiers, hot-swap accounts with Ctrl+Alt+J/K, inspect refreshed /usage cards, and configure context limits per session
- Follow live and completed codemode calls through bounded JavaScript previews that survive status changes and transcript compaction
- See worker lane progress and final reports in completion messages, with clearer wait and recovery outcomes
- Reduce polling and redraws in background windows, preserve focus state across reloads, and reuse immutable transcript and provider request data instead of repeatedly copying it
- Live voice input includes a waveform and streaming draft transcript; model discovery and response-observed usage attribution are improved

### Fixes

- Recover from short network interruptions and HTTP/2 stream errors without prematurely failing the turn or suggesting an unrelated model switch
- Improve account failover acknowledgements, retry cancellation, and protection against stale fallback resends
- Keep the terminal in TUI mode after recovered draw panics, including tiny tmux panes
- Improve cloud handoff recovery, repository replacement safety, reconnection, and in-place runtime reloads
- Avoid repeated redraws for unchanged todo snapshots and repeated reads of completed background-task files

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/1jehuang/jcode/compare/v0.99.1...v1.0.0

name: MinerU 4.2.3
body:
## 4.2.3

- **新增单文件执行超时与托管恢复**。WebUI、Router 和 API Server 支持 `--task-timeout`，默认 `3600` 秒，从取得解析名额开始计时，覆盖解析和服务端产物打包。超时任务返回 `task_timeout`，独立 API 停止接收新任务，由部署方重建服务。Router 通过父进程监督回收超时 worker 及模型子进程，并重新启动服务，即使执行线程、事件循环或取消清理挂起也能触发恢复。
- **改善 WebUI 恢复体验与进程清理**。本地 WebUI 由 Router 托管唯一 worker，恢复期间显示状态，尚未提交的排队请求在服务就绪后继续。旧 worker 上其他未完成请求返回 `worker_restarted`，问题文件可手动重试。完善 Windows 进程树、临时目录与控制通道回收，明确报告模型预加载失败，并在连续三次启动恢复失败后停止自动重试。
- **修复 Doclib 全文检索被图片载荷挤占**。构造检索文本时提取正文、公式和图表说明，再应用字符预算，避免内嵌图片的 base64 内容占满索引而遗漏正文。升级后从解析缓存重建已有索引，并保留跨页内容续接。缓存不完整的文档会记录迁移原因，补齐缓存或重新解析后重启 Doclib 可继续迁移。
- **提前检查 vLLM 与 Transformers 兼容性**。启动引擎前识别 `vllm<0.29.0` 与 `transformers>=5.23.0` 的不兼容组合，并给出升级 vLLM 或调整 Transformers 版本范围的明确提示，减少模型加载阶段难以定位的失败。
- **更新 DocVortex 依赖**。最低版本提升至 `0.6.24`，同步原生文档解析与共享渲染能力的改进。

**配置提示**。Router 的 `--worker-tier` 默认改为 `auto`，由各 worker 根据自己的设备环境确定档位上限。需要固定上限时可显式指定 `flash`、`basic`、`standard` 或 `advanced`。`--task-timeout` 必须为正整数，上传、排队、客户端下载及模型启动预加载各自使用独立的等待与生命周期设置。

---

## 4.2.3

- **Add per-file execution timeouts and managed recovery**. WebUI, Router, and API Server support `--task-timeout`, defaulting to `3600` seconds from acquiring an execution slot through parsing and server-side artifact packaging. Timed-out tasks return `task_timeout`. A standalone API stops accepting new work and relies on its deployment host to recreate the service. Router supervises local workers from the parent process, reclaims timed-out workers and model subprocesses, and restarts the service even when execution threads, the event loop, or cancellation cleanup stall.
- **Improve WebUI recovery and process cleanup**. Local WebUI uses Router to manage a single worker, displays recovery status, and resumes queued requests awaiting submission once the service is ready. Other unfinished requests on the replaced worker return `worker_restarted`, and affected files can be retried manually. Improve Windows process-tree, temporary-directory, and control-channel cleanup, surface model preload failures, and stop automatic recovery after three consecutive startup failures.
- **Keep image payloads out of Doclib full-text indexes**. Build search text from body content, formulas, and figure or table descriptions before applying the character budget, preventing embedded image base64 data from crowding out searchable text. Rebuild existing indexes from cached parse results during upgrade while preserving cross-page continuations. Documents with incomplete caches record a migration reason and can resume migration after restoring or reparsing the cache and restarting Doclib.
- **Check vLLM and Transformers compatibility before startup**. Detect the incompatible combination of `vllm<0.29.0` and `transformers>=5.23.0` before engine initialization, with actionable guidance to upgrade vLLM or select a compatible Transformers range.
- **Update DocVortex**. Raise the minimum version to `0.6.24` for native document parsing and shared rendering improvements.

**Configuration note**. Router now defaults `--worker-tier` to `auto`, allowing each worker to select its tier ceiling from its device environment. Specify `flash`, `basic`, `standard`, or `advanced` for a fixed ceiling. `--task-timeout` requires a positive integer. Uploads, queueing, client downloads, and model startup preloading use their own waiting and lifecycle settings.

升级 / Upgrade

```bash
pip install -U "mineru==4.2.3"
```

[完整变更 / Full changes](https://github.com/opendatalab/MinerU/compare/mineru-4.2.2-released...mineru-4.2.3-released)

body:
# Cua Driver 0.53.0

## Summary

This release adds 1 features and includes 1 fixes.

## Features

- background input for GTK 3 apps on macOS through the AppKit activation event. ([#7950](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/7950))

## Fixes

- keep the agent pointer and badge visible and require them in the recorded video. ([#7569](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/7569))

## Contributors

This release contains maintainer changes only.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
```

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds,
and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and
uninstaller scripts.

## Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest”
pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua
Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:
